description: Offers a warm woody, nutty aroma coupled with notes of pepper, chili and sweetness. An oily Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper sheaths an All-Nicaraguan binder and filler. This full-bodied toro will conquer your palate with its complexity of flavors. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua at the Plasencia Cigars factory for Global Premium Cigars.

The 1502 Emerald Toro was crafted using carefully selected aged tobacco leaves to give it its smooth, unique flavor profile. It is a mild-bodied, box-pressed stick that features a savory light-tan Nicaraguan Corojo Habano-seed wrapper placed over a Nicaraguan binder and long-filler leaves from Mexico and Nicaragua. This specially curated blend offers a palate pleasing sweetness with fruity notes and a relaxing vanilla aroma. The 1502 Emerald is handmade in Nicaragua by Plasencia Cigars for Global Premium Cigars.

The 1502 Ruby Conquistador is a beautifully crafted premium cigar that is as aesthetically pleasing as it is flavorful. This medium to full-bodied toro features a smooth, red-hued Ecuadorian Colorado wrapper that artfully covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Once lit, this gem of a cigar offers an enticing flavor profile with its nutty, woody, and earthy notes. The 1502 Ruby is handmade in Nicaragua by Plasencia Cigars for Global Premium Cigars.

Features a warm tobacco flavor profile highlighted with notes of spice and cedar. This Nicaraguan puro sports a savory maduro wrapper and long-filler leaves and delivers a potent smoking experience. The 1502 Blue Sapphire is handmade in Nicaragua by Plasencia Cigars for Global Premium Cigars.

The 1502 XO is a smooth, rich cigar made with Nicaraguan tobaccos, some aged for over 18 years. It delivers a smooth, complex profile of aged cedar, roasted nuts, dark chocolate, and baking spices, with hints of leather and black pepper on a long, elegant finish. The draw is easy, the burn is even, and the smoke is thick and satisfying. Handcrafted in Nicaragua at the renowned Plasencia factory, the XO is an annual limited-edition release that is sure to impress the medium to full bodied smoker. This cigar is perfect for seasoned smokers who enjoy aged complexity and a long, flavorful finish without being too bold or overpowering. A true celebration of time and craftsmanship.

Creamy, floral, and complex, the PDR A. Flores 1975 Gran Reserva Desflorado layers notes of hay, herbs, nuts, citrus, and soft spice over a smooth, elegant texture. Subtle hints of cherry, leather, and chocolate emerge throughout the smoke, creating a refined profile that stays balanced from start to finish without becoming overpowering.Handcrafted in Tamboril, Dominican Republic, by PDR Cigars, this medium-bodied blend honors master blender Abe Flores and showcases the company's meticulous construction style. The cigar features a Connecticut Desflorado Ecuador wrapper over a Dominican binder, with Dominican and Nicaraguan long fillers. Rolled using the traditional entubado method, the Gran Reserva Desflorado delivers an even burn, excellent draw, and a nuanced smoking experience that combines creamy smoothness with layered botanical complexity.

A bold, medium-bodied stick with spicy, earthy and creamy notes. Its dark Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper covers a binder and filler composed of leaves from the Dominican Republic. Handmade at the Tabacalera William Ventura, the ADVentura Barbarroja's Invasion Corona is a more robust departure from ADVentura's previous releases.

The ADVentura The Conqueror Capitan is a medium bodied toro that features an Ecuadorian H2000 wrapper. This exquisite wrapper is placed over an Indonesian binder, which contains long-filler tobaccos from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. This unique blend will captivate your senses with delicious notes of chocolate, nuts, and cedar. The Conqueror is the third release of the ADVentura brand, which follows the fictional story of two 15th century explorers who set out on a quest to discover “the unknown pleasures of the world.” It is handmade at the famed Tabacalera William Ventura factory in the Dominican Republic.

The ADVentura The Explorer Gran Toro is a medium strength toro that features an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper draped over an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and a filler made of Dominican and Ecuadorian tobaccos that have been aged for 5 to 7 years. This carefully cultivated blend provides interesting notes of spice and chocolate with an overall sweetness. The Explorer is the first release of the ADVentura brand, which follows the fictional story of two 15th century explorers who set out on a quest to discover “the unknown pleasures of the world.” It is hand crafted at the famed Tabacalera William Ventura factory in the Dominican Republic.

Caramel notes heighten this medium strength toro's spicy profile. Its Mexican San Andres wrapper cloaks an Indonesian Sumatra binder, and a Nicaraguan, Ecuadorian and a Dominican Republic filler. The Navigator is the second release of the ADVentura brand, which follows the fictional story of two 15th century explorers who set out on a quest to discover “the unknown pleasures of the world.” The ADVentura the Navigator Cabral is handmade in the Dominican Republic at the famed William Ventura cigar factory.

A medium-bodied cigar with woody, nutty, earthy, chocolatey, and coffee notes. Its USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper covers a Mexican San Andres binder and Nicaraguan, USA, and Dominican filler leaves. Prior to rolling, the tobacco was aged for five years. Once rolled, the cigars are aged for four months to allow the flavors to marry. The Royal Return King's Gold is the fourth release of the ADVentura brand, which follows the fictional story of two 15th century explorers who set out on a quest to discover “the unknown pleasures of the world.” The ADVentura The Royal Return Kings Golden Tooth is right sized for when want to enjoy a flavorful smoke while walking the dog, during a coffee break, or for smoking outdoors on a cold winter's day. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic at the famed William Ventura cigar factory.

Dark cocoa, black pepper, and earthy oak shape the Blackfin's Parlay, a medium-to-full bodied smoke that opens with bold intensity before settling into a steady rhythm of spice, wood, and subtle sweetness. It's structured and dynamic, carrying the kind of balanced aggression that ADVentura's storylines are known for.The cigar is produced at Tabacalera Mina del Rey, the factory owned by ADV & McKay. In the ongoing ADVentura narrative, Blackfin's Parlay represents a “peace” or truce between the Pirate factions of Barbarroja's Invasion and Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge, continuing the brand's storytelling approach, though this time, the box skips the usual audio gimmick.

The ADVentura Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge Maduro High Tide opens with deeper, darker tones than the original, leaning harder into dark cocoa, earth, and leather with a more concentrated natural sweetness. The spice is more pronounced early, and the overall profile feels denser and more structured, with a slower, more deliberate burn and a fuller presence on the palate.The ADVentura Blue Eyed Jack's Revenge Maduro sits in a slightly more aggressive lane than the original. It shares the same core DNA of cocoa, earth, and Maduro sweetness; however, it packs quite the punch. High Tide feels like a focused, amplified take on that foundation. Distilling everything that made the original line a success into a super potent maduro, truly emblematic of what ADVentura has become.

A medium-strength smoke with a deep creamy profile highlighted with nutty and floral notes create an irresistibly sweet smoking indulgence. Its reddish, oily Mexican San Andres wrapper sheaths a Dominican Olor binder and a Dominican filler. The tobaccos for this delightful blend are aged for five years before they are rolled. Afterwards, the cigars are allowed to marinate for six months in climate controlled aging rooms before being boxed and shipped. This meticulous aging process lets the cigar's flavors marry and enhance the smoking experience. The ADVentura Blue Eyed Jacks Revenge cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic. The cigars are tucked in a talking box that delivers a special message to whomever buys it.

A mild to medium-strength cigar with a smooth creamy and toasted bread profile accompanied by an irresistible sweetness and touches of spice and pepper. It features a warm tan Ecuadorian wrapper placed over a Dominican binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler leaves. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This medium bodied Nicaraguan puro sports a Jalapa wrapper known for its flavorful interplay between spice and sweetness. The wrapper covers a Criollo binder and a Corojo and Criollo '98 filler. This unique blend creates a notable smoking experience that is indicative of the exceptional tobacco that comes from this Central American country. The Aganorsa Leaf Rare Leaf Reserve Titan Corojo is hand crafted in Nicaragua, and it is sold at an attainable price that makes it a rare find in the world of premium cigars.

A flavorful, medium-strength long corona with rich notes of earth, cedar, and butter. Its savory Corojo maduro wrapper covers a Corojo binder and Corojo and Criollo '98 medio tiempo filler leaves. Medio tiempo leaves are rare, and they are known for their strength and flavor. The Aganorsa Leaf Signature Selection Maduro Corona Gorda is handmade in Nicaragua.

A flavorful, medium-strength robusto with rich notes of earth, cedar, and butter. Its savory, dark Corojo maduro wrapper covers a Corojo binder and Corojo and Criollo '98 medio tiempo filler leaves. Medio tiempo leaves are rare, and they are known for their strength and flavor. The Aganorsa Leaf Signature Selection Maduro Robusto is handmade in Nicaragua.

A medium strength cigar that offers warm earthy, woody, and spicy notes underscored by a delectable sweetness. This Nicaraguan puro is made of 100% AGANORSA Leaf tobaccos, which are grown on farms owned and operated by Aganorsa Leaf. The Aganorsa Leaf Supreme Leaf Royal Perfecto is a slightly smaller version of its big brother, the Perfecto, but it still provides the same deep satisfying experience you have come to expect from a Supreme Leaf cigar. This limited run was produced with just 2,500 boxes of 10.

This medium strength cigar offers spicy and earthy notes with an overall delicious creaminess. Its Nicaraguan binder and filler are covered by a light-tan Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Aganorsa Leaf Validacion Corojo Gran Robusto is a full-strength smoke that's best enjoyed after a hearty dinner. The cigars undergo a rigorous quality control process before the cigars are finally release. They call it â€śvalidacion,â€ť which is Spanish for validation or validating.

Handmade in Nicaragua, the Aganorsa Leaf Validacion Maduro Gran Robusto is perfect for the experienced cigar lover. The cigars undergo a rigorous quality control process before the cigars are finally release. They call it â€śvalidacion,â€ť which is Spanish for validation or validating.

The Aging Room Bin No. 2 C Major is a medium-strength toro that is chiefly composed of tobacco grown in the rich soils of Omepete, a volcanic island in Nicaragua. Tobacco grown in Omepete is known for being sweet and earthy. It is also grown in small batches, so it is considered rare. The Aging Room Bin No. 2 is a Nicaraguan puro from filler to binder, and it is hand-crafted at the famed Plasencia Cigar factory in Nicaragua.

Cream, cedar, and toasted nuts form the foundation of the Aging Room Blue Amber, accented by a gentle sweetness and refined baking spice. Medium-bodied, the profile is composed, elegant, and complex.Created to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Aging Room, Blue Amber reflects the brand's dedication to balance, aging, and good tobacco. Blended under the direction of Rafael Nodal, using various prized tobaccos, including a Nicaraguan wrapper from AJ Fernandez.

Medium-bodied, the profile is composed, elegant, and complex.Created to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Aging Room, Blue Amber reflects the brand's dedication to balance, aging, and good tobacco. Blended under the direction of Rafael Nodal, using various prized tobaccos, including a Nicaraguan wrapper from AJ Fernandez.

This full-bodied toro offers satisfying earthy, spicy, leathery, and cocoa notes. It is a Nicaraguan puro that sports a smooth reddish-brown Habano wrapper. The Aging Room Pura Cepa Mezzo is handmade by Plasencia Cigars in Nicaragua.

This mild-strength Churchill provides a rich creamy indulgence with notes of sweetness and roasted nuts. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper cloaks a binder and filler made of Dominican tobacco. The Aging Room Quattro Connecticut Concerto is hand crafted in the Dominican Republic.

This potent Churchill delivers savory notes of spice, cedar and coffee. Its Dominican binder and filler are cloaked by a rustic, dark-tan Sumatra wrapper. Made of carefully aged leaves, the Aging Room Quattro Original Concerto is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Aging Room Quattro F55M Concerto is a rich, full-bodied Dominican churchill which takes the hugely successful Quattro F55 and replaces the Sumatra wrapper with a gorgeous, leathery Mexican San Andres wrapper. The result is a delicious cornucopia of notes including cocoa, cedar, and earth, with a smooth yet spicy finish that will satisfy your palate from first puff to last.

This full-bodied yet balanced Churchill offers rich notes of cedar, chocolate, and earth. It is a Nicaraguan puro that features an oily dark chocolatey maduro wrapper. The Aging Room Quattro Nicaragua Concerto is expertly hand crafted in Nicaragua at AJ Fernandez's Tabacalera Fernandez factory.

This full-bodied yet balanced torpedo offers delicious notes of cedar, chocolate, and earth. It is a Nicaraguan puro that features a rustic, oily, dark chocolatey maduro wrapper. The Aging Room Quattro Nicaragua Maestro is expertly hand crafted in Nicaragua at AJ Fernandez's Tabacalera Fernandez factory.

This potent toro delivers savory notes of spice, cedar and coffee. Its Dominican binder and filler are cloaked by a rustic, dark-tan Sumatra wrapper. Made of carefully aged leaves, the Aging Room Quattro Original Vibrato is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-strength cigar that offers an arrangement of savory spicy, earthy, and coffee notes with touches of sweetness. This 100% Nicaraguan puro sports a dark chocolatey maduro wrapper. The cigars are handmade at AJ  Fernandez's factory in Nicaragua, and uses tobacco grown exclusively on farms owned by Fernandez. Brand owner Rafael Nodal's passion for music inspired him to create the Aging Room Quattro Sonata.

A medium-bodied robusto with notes of earth, black pepper, sweetness, oak and a delicious chocolatey aroma. A red-hued Cuban-seed hybrid wrapper covers this Nicaraguan puro's binder and filler. The rare Pelo de Oro tobacco is included in the filler, which adds to the cigar's distinct flavor profile. The blend for the collection was developed by Rafael Nodal and AJ Fernandez, two gifted and globally-recognized cigar crafters. The Aging Room Rare Collection Festivo is handmade in Nicaragua.

A full-strength smoke that offers a refined smoking indulgence and masterfully balances its potency with a rich complexity of flavors. This Nicaraguan puro features a dark, savory maduro wrapper cloaking premium tobacco leaves sourced from AJ Fernandez's farms in Nicaragua. The cigars are handmade at the Tabacalera AJ Fernandez Cigars factory in Nicaragua, which is owned and operated by AJ Fernandez. The AJ Fernandez 20th Anniversary cigar was crafted to celebrate AJ Fernandez's two decades of creating memorable cigars. Once the cigars are made, they are banded and placed in a collectible box that commemorates this special occasion. This is a limited-edition cigar. Only 7,500 boxes of 20 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

The Aladino Declaration is a special, limited release from JRE Tobacco Co. created to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence in 2026. Made entirely with tobacco grown by the Eiroa family, the blend remains undisclosed but continues the company's tradition of producing Honduran puros at its factory in Las Lomas, Jamastran.Each box contains 13 cigars as a tribute to the 13 original American colonies. The packaging also reflects this theme. The exterior displays the historic 13-colony flag, and the inside of the lid features the modern American flag along with the famous passage from the Declaration of Independence, honoring life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. Produced in limited quantities, the Aladino Declaration serves as both a collectible release and a tribute to the spirit of American independence and freedom.

The Aladino 85 Aniversario Reserva is a smooth, aromatic, and flavorful mild-to-medium cigar that delivers a refined profile of cedar, cinnamon, chestnuts, and lingering floral notes. Crafted using the rare Cuban Pinareño seed, an even more delicate and disease-prone varietal than Corojo, this cigar scratches the classic Cuban itch. Though it joins the JRE portfolio as a permanent offering, its production remains limited, with only four boxes per vitola released each month, due to the meticulous craftsmanship and rarity of the leaf. A must try for Aladino fans, lovers of Honduran tobacco, and people seeking rare and unique cigars.

Notes of earth, spice, cedar and pepper meld to give this medium-strength cigar its Cubanesque flavor profile. Its Honduran Corojo binder and filler is covered by a Honduran Cameroon-seed wrapper. The Aladino Cameroon Robusto is handmade in Honduras by the JRE Tobacco Company, which is a family owned and operated company. It is considered one of the top Corojo tobacco grower in the industry.

Delicious notes of sweetness, nuts, and cedar accompanied by hints of pepper contribute to defining this cigar's flavor profile. The Aladino Cameroon Reserva cigar is considered the first ever premium cigar made entirely of Cameroon-seed tobacco that is grown in Honduras. The tobacco was grown at the JRE Tobacco farm and the cigars are handmade at their factory. From first to last puff this premiere blend offers a unique smoking experience you will not want to miss, so be sure to buy it by the box.

A smooth, mild cigar with pleasing notes of grass, spice, sweetness, cedar, and tobacco. The cigar's alluring candela wrapper covers a binder and filler made of the Eiroa family's own Corojo tobaccos. The Aladino Candela is handmade in Honduras at the JRE Tobacco Company factory, which is owned and operated by the father and son team of Julio and Justo Eiroa.

Handcrafted by the JRE Tobacco Company in Jamastran Valley, Honduras, the Aladino Churchill is a medium-bodied cigar that brings back the Golden Era of Cuban cigar making. The Aladino is a Honduran puro that is skillfully made from the Corojo leave from filler to wrapper, which is grown by the world-famous Eiroa Tobacco Farm. The Aladino offers an interesting flavor profile that consists of cedar, citrus, and coffee.

This medium-bodied cigar delivers notes of cedar, tobacco, pepper and earth with a hint of floral. It is a Honduran puro with a Habano-seed maduro wrapper, a Corojo binder and a Habano-seed filler. Handmade in Honduras at the Fabrica de Puros Aladino factory, the Aladino Classic Toro is a traditional smoke with a Cubanesque look and feel.

A mild to medium strength cigar with pleasing notes of cedar, nuts, and cream with a woody retro-hale. Its alluring, light-brown Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper surrounds a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras, the Aladino Connecticut Robusto pairs well with a cup of your favorite coffee.

Classic notes of cedar, pepper and tobacco will greet you when you light up this full-strength stick. This Honduran puro features a Corojo wrapper over a binder and filler made from premium tobaccos. Expertly handmade in Honduras, the Aladino Corojo Reserva LE Robusto brings back cigar crafting's golden years.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Corona is handmade in Honduras.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Elegante is handmade in Honduras.

A potent, full-bodied smoke packed with deep spicy, coffee, and earthy notes. Its muscular maduro wrapper covers a binder and filler composed of tobaccos grown in farms owned and operated by the Eiroa family in Honduras. The Aladino Fuma Noche delivers an invigorating smoking experience that will appeal to veteran smokers or novices looking to expand their smoking horizons. This cigar is best enjoyed after a hearty meal. The cigars are handmade in Hondura by the JRE Tobacco Co.

The Aladino Chimp Gorbusto is a 4½ x 60 cigar crafted by JRE Tobacco Co., featuring a Honduran-grown Cameroon-seed wrapper. This short, stout vitola is a slow burner and offers a medium-bodied experience that showcases the unique character of Cameroon leaf cultivated in Honduras. This refined, complex smoke unfolds slowly, much like the thoughts of the smoker after lighting up. Initially released exclusively to retailers who attended JRE's farm experience in Honduras, this unique vitola and blend marks the launch of a new Aladino line scheduled to have fresh releases every year. You may also enjoy the Corojo and Maduro blends that are also a part of this inaugural release.

The Aladino Gorbusto Gori is a 4½ x 60 cigar crafted by JRE Tobacco Co., featuring an undisclosed Maduro wrapper. This short, stout vitola is a slow burner and offers a rich and flavorful full-bodied experience that showcases the excellence of JRE Tobaccos Honduran style. Bold, assertive, and unmistakably full in body, this cigar was blended to reflect the character of the smoker. Initially released exclusively to retailers who attended JRE's farm experience in Honduras, this unique vitola and blend marks the launch of a new Aladino line scheduled to have fresh releases every year. You may also enjoy the Chimp and Orang blends which are different, more nuanced expressions of the line.

The Aladino Gorbusto Orang is a 4½ x 60 Honduran puro featuring JRE Tobacco's signature Corojo wrapper. With its compact build and slow burn, we have a medium-bodied stick packed with classic Corojo character, it offers a rich and balanced smoke. Expressive and free-spirited, Orang is the energy in the room. His cigar is as unexpected as he is: creative in flavor, bold in character, and unlike anything else in the lineup. Initially released exclusively to retailers who attended JRE's farm experience in Honduras, this unique vitola and blend marks the launch of a new Aladino line, scheduled to have new releases every year.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Gordo is handmade in Honduras.

This medium strength cigar offers notes of earth, chocolate, and cream. Its oily, dark Habano wrapper surrounds a binder and filler composed of Corojo tobacco made from original Cuban-seed Corojo. After rolling, the cigars are aged for four to five years to let the tobaccos marry and develop their unique flavor profile. This awesome Honduran puro was created to bring back the golden years of Cuban cigars, which took place in the late forties to the early sixties. The Aladino Habano Rothschild Vintage Selection is handmade in Honduras by the JRE Tobacco Company.

The Aladino Habano Toro Vintage Selection is handmade in Honduras by the JRE Tobacco Company.

This medium-strength cigar offers notes of earth and leather with hints of sweetness and spice. Its mouth-watering, dark Mexican San Andres wrapper cloaks a Honduran Corojo binder and filler. This pleasant blend pairs well with an IPA beer, cognac, or a port wine. The Aladino Maduro Box Pressed Robusto is handmade in Honduras.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Patton is handmade in Honduras.

A medium strength cigar with a unique flavor profile and a deep complexity. It features a warm brown Sumatra-seed wrapper that was grown in Honduras on farms owned by JRE Tobacco. This savory capa is expertly draped over a Honduran binder and filler that was also grown on company farms. Handmade at the JRE Tobacco Company factory in Honduras, the Aladino Sumatra cigars are placed in a contemporary box, but each sports the traditional, globally recognized Aladino cigar band and distinctive tissue packaging.

A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice. It is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Toro is handmade in Honduras.

Cedar, earth, and baking spice lead the profile of the Alec Bradley Thirty Years, supported by notes of toasted nuts and a subtle natural sweetness. Full-bodied and well-balanced, it delivers a layered smoking experience that reflects the brand's evolution over time.Created to commemorate three decades of Alec Bradley, this release is designed to reflect the brands history. The blend features a Honduran Trojes wrapper over a dual binder of Honduran Jamastran and Nicaraguan Jalapa, with fillers from Estelí and Jalapa in Nicaragua alongside Honduran tobaccos from Jamastran and Trojes. Crafted as a milestone cigar, Thirty Years showcases a mature, confident approach to blending that really comes through in the smoke.

Delectable notes of cedar, nuts, coffee and chocolate will greet your palate when you light up this medium strength cigar. Its light-brown Honduran wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Offering an excellent construction and smooth draw along with its refined blend, this cigar was crafted to recreate the classic cigars of years ago. The Alec Bradley American Classic Blend Robusto is handmade at the Plasencia factory in Nicaragua.

This bold, medium-strength cigar has a spicy profile tempered by notes of cocoa and leather. Its inviting red-hued Sun-grown wrapper covers a binder and filler made of leaves from Jalapa, Nicaragua. The Alec Bradley American Sun Grown Churchill is handmade at the Plasencia Cigars factory in Nicaragua.

This potent cigar delivers notes of cedar with touches of spice and cream. Its rustic Honduran maduro wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan and Honduran binder and Nicaraguan Criollo '98 and Corojo '98 filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Alec & Bradley Blind Faith Robusto is the first release by Alan Rubin's sons Alec and Bradley, which the company was named after.

The Alec Bradley Chunk Maduro delivers a naturally sweet blend that has a flavorful and balanced profile with notes of cocoa, roasted nuts, cedar, and a touch of black pepper. This short gordo contains long filler Dominican and Nicaraguan tobacco, a Honduran binder, and a Mexican San Andres wrapper. With an exceptional price and quality relationship, this medium to full bodied cigar offers a great ride for half the fare. The 2XL vitola is being made in limited quantities, while the rest of the line will become a standard offering.

The Alec Bradley Chunk Shade delivers smooth flavors of tea, hay, and bready toast in a mellow medium profile. These short, stout cigars feature a Honduran-grown Connecticut Shade wrapper, a U.S. Broadleaf binder, and a filler blend from three countries. With a large ring gauge, soft but flavorful profile, this cigar gives a lot more than it takes. Alec Bradleys Chunk line is a great pick when you want a lot without spending a lot.

This mild to medium strength cigar offers creamy and nutty notes with a floral aroma. Its smooth Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Nicaraguan and Honduran filler. The Alec Bradley Connecticut Torpedo is handmade in Honduras.

This medium-bodied stick offers a smooth profile with notes of nuts, nutmeg, and leather. Its Honduran Trojes wrapper covers a binder and filler composed of Nicaraguan and Honduran leaves. The cigar is named after the farm in Torjes, Honduras where the tobacco for this delectable cigar's wrapper is grown. The Alec Bradley Coyol Double Churchill is handmade at the Raices Cubanas factory in Honduras.

Smooth and complex from the first draw, Do Not Disturb delivers a refined flavor profile of earth, hay, and cedar, with a subtle spice that gradually intensifies, making for a mellow yet evolving experience. Produced in the Dominican Republic at Tabacalera La Isla, this medium-bodied cigar features an Ecuadorian Connecticut-seed wrapper, a Dominican Criollo binder, and a well-balanced filler blend of Dominican and Mexican tobaccos. Alec Bradley crafted Do Not Disturb as an invitation to pause, unwind, and savor a moment of peace, perfect for quiet reflection or relaxed conversation.

A medium to full-bodied stick with deep notes of spice, earth, coffee and sweetness. Its Honduran Broadleaf wrapper and binder sheaths filler leaves from Honduras and Nicaragua. Handmade in Honduras, the Alec Bradley Double Broadleaf Chunk delivers a bold smoking indulgence that showcases the broadleaf's alluring flavor and aroma.

This medium-strength cigar begins with a spicy, nutty profile that shifts to creamy and chocolatey notes. Its Honduran maduro wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a Honduran and Nicaraguan filler. Once rolled specially selected blend is finished off with a distinct pig tail. The Alec Bradley Family Blend The Lineage Robusto is handmade at the Raices Cubanas Factory in Honduras.

This not so spooky medium bodied smoke offers a frightfully delightful smoking indulgence with its rich cocoa notes and touches of honey sweetness. Its alluring barber pole wrapper consists of a USA Connecticut Broadleaf entwined with an Ecuadorian Habano leaf. This eye-catching wrapper shrouds an Indonesian Besuki binder which is stuffed with Dominican Piloto leaves as well as leaves from Jalapa, Esteli, and Condega, which are three of Nicaragua's top tobacco growing regions. Bold flavors of dark fruit, earth and cocoa are dominant. A mix of cinnamon and pepper back up the almost meaty, chewy finish. The retro has black Cherry and licorice notes blended with mineral and white pepper spice.

A mild hint of black pepper quickly transitions into floral, almost lavender notes with an herbal finish. A blend of different mild spices is always present in the background and in the retro. The finish is floral, creamy and very balanced.

The beginning is full of bright cedar notes backed up with white pepper and dried fruits. The herbal, floral and earthy cocoa come into play towards the finish with a blend of pepper and baking spice on the retro.
Layers of mixed spice blend with notes of coffee, malt and cocoa. It has a long finish with flavors of wood and baking spice.

The original Brick House cigars were Cuban puros, handmade with the finest Havana tobaccos. Third-generation cigar makers, Eric and Bobby Newman, have recreated this vintage cigar brand by blending specially aged Nicaraguan tobaccos with hearty Havana Subido wrapper leaves to match the rich, well balanced flavor of their grandfathers Brick House cigars. This flavorful Churchill was rated 91 by Cigar Aficionado.

As far as the blend goes, these Brick House is On Fire TAAs are no different than your standard Brick House. It's what they do with the blend that makes it unique. This TAA exclusive version of Brick House has a shaggy foot, meaning that for the first inch or two, you taste none of the binder or wrapper and all of the filler. This makes for an incredibly unique experience when smoking a shaggy foot. You get to experience the fillers of the blend before hitting the binder and wrapper; in this way, the blend plays out in front of you like a film. If you're a fan of J.C. This cigar is named after the farm which produces the wrapper for this cigar, the Coyolar farm. This is a farm that Julio Eiroa had wanted to grow cigar wrappers on for some time, because of its great climate and quality of the soil. The Camacho Coyolar Puro is the first cigar produced with the wrapper from the Coyolar farm. It has a full bodied, yet smooth, flavor. This Robusto is the perfect size to introduce you to this brand. If you like the rest of the Camacho line, you should try this one.

The Camacho Criollo Toro delivers spice on the first few puffs, mellowing down to some earthy, nutty medium bodied flavors. A more mellow cigar within the Camacho brand.

From 2013-2015 the Diploma was re-blended from its initial offering, using multi-national components, and then swiftly discontinued. Now with its resurrection, you can indulge in what the Diploma was always meant to be: the absolute highest-grade Corojo primings available on the Camacho farm in Honduras. Hand-selected and masterfully rolled, this full-bodied smoke provides a smooth leathery spice that only top-shelf Corojo can attain. Enjoy the best of the best. Limited to 1,800 boxes yearly.

Only 1,500 collectible boxes of 20 cigars per box were made so be sure to order yours today.

Made up of an oily Honduran Maduro wrapper on top of premium Honduran Corojo binder and filler, this bold and complex smoke will satisfy your palate with notes of earth, leather, cocoa and spice. Packaged in American flag themed coffins, this throwback is just a quick walk down Memory Lane, as the tobacco used is so rare only 1,500 boxes were produced. Dont miss your chance to reminisce.

Only 2,550 boxes of 20-cigars per box were made, so declare your independence from the same old, same old and order yours today before they're all gone.

Once rolled, the cigars are carefully aged in Spanish cedar-lined aging rooms to allow their flavors to fully develop. Handmade in Nicaragua, the CAO Amazon Basin Extra Anejo is a limited-release cigar only 5,000 boxes of 18 cigars per box were made so order yours today.

A pleasing smoke with cedar and creamy notes. Its eye-catching Connecticut Broadleaf and Shade wrapper covers a Brazilian binder and a Connecticut, Brazilian, Italian, and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in Honduras, the CAO America Monument received a 90 Rating from Cigar Aficionado.

The CAO Arcana STOKK is a unique cigar that blends traditional long-filler tobacco with Cyprian Latakia pipe tobacco, a first for CAO. It blends the deep smoky character of Dominican Andullo, a fermentation method involving palm bark, and the bold, tangy punch of Latakia. Made in collaboration with the Danish pipe tobacco house Stokkebye, it brings a pipe-like twist to a premium handmade cigar. It's a one-of-a-kind blend that stands out for its flavor shifts and originality.

This mild flavored cigar offers a soothing vanilla aroma and flavor. Its Cameroon wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler that has been misted with an extract made of Madagascar vanilla beans. These beans are considered the best in the world. The CAO Flavours Bella Vanilla Corona is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A full-bodied stick with woody, nutty and vanilla notes. Its muscular Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers a Connecticut Shade binder and a Dominican Piloto Cubano, Honduran and Nicaraguan filler. The CAO Bones Maltese Cross Gigante is a medium to full-bodied stick that is handmade in Nicaragua. This is a kickback and relax cigar that's meant to be enjoyed with friends at a BBQ, or while playing a game of dominoes or dice. Each vitola in the series is named after a game of dominoes. And, each box purchase comes with a set of dice. So “start tossing them bones” and order a box or two today!

This savory smoke offers satisfying notes of chocolate, cinnamon, and espresso. Its Brazilian Mata Fina wrapper covers a Brazilian binder and a Brazilian, Nicaraguan, Honduran and Mexican filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the CAO BX3 Robusto is a medium-bodied smoke that provides a memorable and mesmerizing smoking experience. It pairs well with bourbon or aged rum. This must-have stick gets its unique name “BX3” and distinct flavors from the fact that is uses Brazilian tobaccos times three in its blend.

This is a well-balanced cigar with spicy, earthy, coffee, and sweetness. Its smooth, red-hued Grade One African Cameroon wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the CAO Cameroon Perfecto is a mild to medium smoke with an excellent construction. It received a 92 rating by Cigar Aficionado.

A mild flavored cigar that exudes a cherry and black currant aroma and vanilla flavor underscored by natural tobacco. Its Cameroon wrapper sheaths a Dominican binder and filler. To preserve is tantalizing aroma and flavor each cigar is nested in an aluminum tube. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Flavours Cherrybomb Tubos offers a short but flavorful smoking experience.

A medium-bodied cigar with earthy and nutty notes and a sweet, salty finish. Its oily Honduran wrapper covers a Cameroon binder and a filler made of rare Colombian Ica Mazinga leaves. These leaves are known to provide a sharp burn and an effortless draw. The CAO Colombia Bogota is handmade in Nicaragua.

A medium-bodied cigar that delivers notes of earth, cinnamon and nuts. Its Brazilian Mata Fina wrapper sheaths a Honduran binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua, Colombia and the Dominican Republic. This five-nation blend pairs well with a bourbon or stout beer. The CAO Consigliere Soldier is handmade in Nicaragua.

This flavor infused cigar has a white chocolate truffles and Irish cream profile with notes of hazelnut, cocoa, and vanilla. Its Cameroon wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Flavours Eileen's Dream Corona will appeal to smokers looking for a short but flavorful smoke.

This medium-bodied smoke's syrupy sweetness is accented with lively notes of white pepper and a peppery retro-hale. Its ultra dark USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper sheaths a Cameroon binder, and a Dominican Piloto Cubano and Nicaraguan filler. The CAO FASA Noche is a great companion to a whisky or an after dinner espresso. Plus, it's wallet-friendly price makes it an excellent everyday smoke. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

A mild to medium bodied premium long filler cigar with a creamy smoke texture, light natural sweetness, touch of spice, hay, and nuts. This is a lovely choice for a smoker seeking a cigar that balances a flavorful but mellow taste profile. Constructed out of an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade grown wrapper, Cameroon binder, and fillers from the Dominican and Nicaragua that delivers a quality experience in a price bracket that doesnt have a lot of competition.

This potent, box-pressed stick delivers chocolatey, sweetness and peppery notes. Its dark Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Connecticut binder and a Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the inspiration for the CAO Flathead V642 Piston came from the flathead engines of classic muscle cars.

The CAO Fuma Em Corda is a dark Toro with a filler that is composed of the rare Brazilian Bragança tobacco which is blended with Honduran and Nicaraguan tobaccos. The cigar then undergoes a unique six-month fermentation process. Once ready, the Fum Em Cordas filler is then surrounded by a Cameron binder, which is enveloped by a Honduran corojo wrapper. All of this culminates into making the CAO Fuma Em Corda a potent full-bodied smoke with an earthy and fruity profile.

Mild and flavorful this smooth smoke offers notes of vanilla, cream and nutmeg. It sports an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper placed over an Ecuadorian binder and a Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the CAO Gold Label Robusto has a solid construction and has received a 90-rating from Cigar Aficionado.

A potent smoke with an earthy and sweetness profile accompanied by spicy and fruity notes. Its Honduran maduro wrapper covers a Honduran binder and filler leaves from Italy, Nicaragua and Peru. The CAO Italia Ciao offers a hearty and flavorful smoking indulgence that pairs well with a single malt scotch. It was name Robb Report's Best of the Best in 2005. Handmade in Honduras.

The CAO Surplus Maduro is a handmade bundle cigar produced in Honduras, built with a Mexican San Andrés Maduro wrapper over an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and Dominican Olor long-filler. It's designed as a straightforward, no-frills option that delivers traditional long-filler construction at an everyday price, with enough bite and strength to know you're smoking, but balanced enough to enjoy any time. It is also available in Shade and Sweet versions, giving smokers additional options for a lighter profile or a touch of added flavor.

This mild infused cigar exudes flavors of natural exotic fruit and bourbon vanilla along with notes of caramel and honey. Its Cameroon wrapper sheaths a Dominican binder and filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Flavours Moontrance Corona offer a savory smoke that can be enjoyed any time of day.

Sweet maduro that has some spice, some wood, and overall performs well. The blend combines a well-fermented Connecticut Broadleaf Maduro wrapper, a Brazilian maduro binder, and fillers from Nicaragua, honduras, Dominican Republic and Peru. This rich and intense robusto has made the Robb Report Best of the Best list.

This medium strength cigar delivers notes of nuts, vanilla, toast and pepper. It sports a Honduran Colorado wrapper, a Honduran binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua: Esteli, Jalapa and Condega. These are Nicaragua's top-tobacco producing regions. The CAO Nicaragua Granada is handmade in Nicaragua.

This is a full-strength, full-bodied stick that delivers bold notes of spice, earth and sweetness. Its rare Brazilian Cubra wrapper covers a binder and filler of undisclosed origins. Handmade in Nicaragua, the CAO Orellana Limited Edition Toro will have you coming back for more so be sure to order several boxes.

A medium strength cigar that delivers notes of nuts, cedar, spice, sweetness and cocoa. It features an Ecuadorian Habano maduro wrapper draped over a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The CAO Pilon is named after the Pilon,” which is a stack of dried tobacco leaves that is created to begin the process of fermentation. This is an old Cuban method that allows for natural fermentation with maximum flavor and color. The cigar's silky Ecuadorian Habano wrapper leaf has been fermented in a pilon. The CAO Pilon Churchill is handmade in Nicaragua.

Warm notes of earth, nuts and chocolate will greet you when you light up this medium bodied stick. Its Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers a Dominican binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the CAO Session Shop makes for a great everyday smoke and pairs well with coffee or Cognac.

The CAO Surplus Shade bundle is a handmade cigar produced at STG Danlí with a focus on straightforward, reliable quality. It uses a Honduran Connecticut wrapper over an Ecuador Sumatra binder and Dominican Olor filler, a traditional combination chosen for balance and approachability. Designed as an affordable bundle, it highlights how classic long-filler construction can be delivered in a simple, no-frills format. It is also available in Maduro and Sweet versions, giving smokers additional options for a punchier profile or a touch of added flavor.

The CAO Surplus Sweet bundle is an easy smoking medium bodied handmade cigar designed to deliver approachable flavor at everyday value. It features an Ecuador Sumatra wrapper over a matching Sumatra binder with a core of Dominican Olor long-filler, known for its light spice and aromatic character. A sweetened cap subtly influences the smoke, adding a gentle layer of delight that complements the natural tobacco flavors. Rolled at STG Danlí, it reflects traditional handcraft presented in a simple, budget-friendly format. It is also available in Maduro and Shade versions, giving smokers additional options punchier and more mellow natural profiles.

This potent stick delivers rich earthy, nutty, cocoa and spicy notes complemented with a satisfying sweetness. Its dark, oily Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The cigar was originally released in 2008 as a tribute to Mexico and its fine tobacco. The cigar is named after Zocalo, a main square in Mexico City that is now known as Plaza de la Constitucion. The cigar still maintains its original blend, but the packaging and the band has been given a new look that was inspired by the Mexican flag. The CAO Zocalo Gigante is handmade in Nicaragua.

The Casa 1910 Mexigars MX-1 is crafted entirely on Mexican soil, this 6 x 52 Toro is a celebration of the country's finest tobaccos, anchored by the legendary San Andrés leaf. Its medium-bodied profile delivers a dynamic flavor journey, showcasing the earthy complexity and spice that San Andrés is known for. A proud tribute to Mexico's deep-rooted cigar tradition, launched in 2024 as part of the Mexigars line—an homage to the bold spirit and rich soil of the nation. From seed to ash, the MX-1 is a love letter to Mexico's tobacco-growing heritage.

The Casa 1910 MexiGars MX-2, introduced in 2024, is a bold tribute to Mexico's storied tobacco tradition, crafted entirely in Mexico using 100% Mexican-grown tobaccos. Showcasing a Mexican Habano wrapper, a hearty Mexican Negro San Andrés binder, and a filler blend of Mexican Negro San Andrés and Habano Mexico Especial, this cigar embodies the depth and complexity for which Mexican tobacco is renowned. Created to deliver premium quality at an accessible price, the MX-2 invites both seasoned aficionados and curious newcomers to experience the rich legacy and craftsmanship of Mexico's cigar heritage.

The Casa Carrillo 2025 TAA Exclusive offers notable depth from its Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper, balanced by a smooth Dominican binder and rich fillers from Nicaragua and the U.S. Tasting notes of earth, cocoa, sweetness, and subtle spice accompany this potent stick. This limited-edition 6 x 54 box-pressed toro is produced at the Casa Carrillo factory in the Dominican Republic. With only 1,000 boxes of 10 cigars available, the release was only distributed to authorized TAA retailers. The result is an exclusive, full-bodied, and refined smoking experience suitable for any palate.

The Perez-Carrillo Ascend opens with layered notes of cedar, roasted nuts, earth, and soft spice, delivering a smooth medium-bodied profile with refined balance from start to finish. Subtle sweetness and creaminess round out the smoke, giving it an approachable character while still offering enough depth to stay engaging.Created by Casa Carrillo as a new addition to the Perez-Carrillo lineup, Ascend is positioned as a more accessible, everyday expression of the company's blending style. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the cigar emphasizes balance, construction, and flavor transitions throughout the cigar, continuing the Carrillo family's long-standing focus on craftsmanship and consistency.

Subtle hints of spice highlight this mild cigar's flavor profile. Its light-brown Ecuadorian Connecticut shade wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder, and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Casa Cuevas Connecticut Toro is a great smoke any time of day.

This potent stick offers notes of leather, nuts, black pepper, coffee and sweetness. Its tan Ecuadorian Habano wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and a Colombian, Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. It is Casa Cuevas first full-bodied, full-strength stick. It features a pigtail cap and a shaggy foot, which showcases the Cuevas' skills at crafting a cigar that is a feast for the eyes as it is for the palate. La Mandarria is Spanish for sledgehammer, and like its name, this stick will shatter all of your preconceptions of what a great cigar should be. The Casa Cuevas La Mandarria LE Toro is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium bodied stick with notes of earth, cedar and nuts. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler leaves from Colombia, Pennsylvania, Nicaragua and Dominican Republic. Handmade in the Dominican Republic at Tabacalera Las Lavas, the Casa Cuevas Limited Edition Habano Flaco offers a blissful smoking experience you won't want to miss.

This full-bodied stick delivers notes of spice, earth and sweetness. Its Mexican San Andres Maduro wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a Colombian, Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Pennsylvanian filler. Hand crafted in the Dominican Republic at Tabacalera Las Lavas, the Casa Cuevas Limited Edition Maduro Flaco offers a palate pleasing experience you must try.

This full-bodied smoke offers notes of spice and pepper. Its Honduran Corojo Colorado wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and filler leaves from the Dominican Republic, Nicaragua and Peru. The Casa Cuevas Patrimonio Robusto Gordo is a celebratory premium cigar created by Luis Cuevas Jr. and his son Alec to commemorate their family's proud legacy of crafting fine cigars. Handmade at the Cueva's Tabacalera las Lavas, SRL factory in the Dominican Republic, this is one box worthy tribute cigar, so be sure to order more than one.

A balanced, medium-strength cigar with a spicy and sweetness flavor profile. Its Mexican San Andres Maduro wrapper sheaths a Dominican Piloto Cubano binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Casa Cuevas Reserva Maduro Toro is part of the Cuevas signature line.

A potent stick packed with spicy, creamy, and sweetness notes. Its Cameroon Colorado wrapper covers a Corojo binder, and a filler composed of Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Pennsylvania Broadleaf leaves. Handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Tabacalera Las Lavas factory, the Casa Cuevas Sangre Nueva Robusto offers a bold and savory smoking experience that appeals to contemporary as well as traditional aficionados.

A pleasant mild to medium-strength cigar with a deep creaminess and teasing notes of baker's spice, dark coffee, and a warm earthiness. Its smooth, golden Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Casa de Garcia Centenario Gold Label is a value-priced cigar that's perfect for a weekend BBQ or a morning smoke. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua by Plasencia Cigars.

A potent and flavorful smoke that delivers notes of sweet spice, earth, and hints of coffee. A binder and filler made of Nicaraguan leaves supports the cigar's red-hued Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. The Casa de Garcia Centenario Red Label is a wallet-friendly cigar that appeals to the contemporary or traditional smoker who is looking for a great everyday smoke.

With its Dominican and Honduran long filler tobaccos, smooth Connecticut binder and light brown Connecticut shade wrapper, the Casa de Garcia Connecticut Magnum is a cheap smoke that gives you a lot of bang for your buck. These are well made, mild cigars that come in bundles of 20 cigars.

Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Casa de Garcia Maduro Robusto sports a rich, dark Connecticut shade wrapper that is draped over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and specially aged Dominican and Honduran long-filler tobaccos. A medium-strength cigar, the Casa de Garcia Maduro offers up a well-balanced combination of flavors that includes cocoa, chocolate, and cedar with a hint of spice.

This full-bodied toro provides a flavorful experience with a rich complexity. Its all-Nicaraguan blend is made of leaves from Nicaragua's top-tobacco regions: Jalapa, Condega and Esteli. The Casa Fernandez Miami Reserva Toro is handmade in Miami, Florida.

This potent stick has a rich complexity with pleasing notes of cedar, coffee, cinnamon and a toasty finish. It is a Nicaraguan puro with a reddish maduro wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua at the Plasencia Cigars factory, the blend for Casa Magna Colorado Robusto was created by renowned master blenders Manuel Quesada and Nestor Plasencia.

A flavorful, full-strength cigar with creamy and spicy notes and hints of earth and coffee. Its smooth, light-tan Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper sheaths a Nicaraguan binder and filler. This contrasting blend creates an intense smoking experience that will delight the veteran as well as the novice smoker. The Casa Magna Connecticut Robusto is handmade at Quesada's Tabacos de Exportacion in the Dominican Republic.

Casa Magna D. Magnus II Optimus is an oval pressed Corona Gorda cigar that will delight your palate with earthy, toasty, leathery notes and hints of sweet cocoa. The cigar is finished with a pigtail cap and is made by Plasencia in partnership with Manolo Quesada.

A flavorful and potent cigar that offers up notes of chocolate, pepper, cedar, and nuts along with a long finish. This Nicaraguan puro sports a rustic, reddish maduro wrapper and it is stuffed with a premium Nicaraguan tobacco. The Casa Magna D. Magnus II Caligula is a long, thick box-pressed shaped cigar with a tapered head and foot. At first glance, the cigar looks round, but, when picked up, you soon see its true shape. This uniquely rolled cigar is indicative of the fine craftsmanship that has become a staple of Plasencia Cigars, which hand crafts the cigars for Quesada Cigars.

The Casa Magna Jalapa Claro Gran Toro was created by renowned master blenders Manuel Quesada and Nestor Plasencia, and is a medium-bodied Nicaraguan puro made at the Plasencia factory in Esteli. Rich and complex, this chocolate-hued toro offers deep notes of espresso, cedar, and mint throughout its peppery finish.

A potent stick that offers notes of spice, black pepper, sweetness and an earthy aroma. Its dark Ecuadorian Sun-grown Corojo wrapper covers a Dominican binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. This three-nation blend combines to deliver a balanced smoking indulgence. The Casa Magna Liga F Toro is handmade at Quesada's Tabacos de Exportacion (TABADEX) factory in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-strength cigar with a spicy, earthy, and sweetness profile. Its smooth, dark chocolatey Mexican San Andres wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and a filler composed of Nicaraguan, Dominican, and USA leaves. This savory four-nation blend was developed by Raquel Quesada, President of Quesada Cigars and her father, globally recognized cigar crafter, Manolo Quesada. The Casa Magna Maduro TAA Exclusive Toro Box Press cigar is handmade at the Quesada's Tabacos de Exportacion (TABADEX) factory in the Dominican Republic. This exclusive cigar is only available through members of the Tobacconists' Association of America (TAA), which Neptune Cigars is a proud member of. This is a limited-edition cigar. Only 300 boxes of 20 cigars per box were made. Order yours today! The TAA is a members only organization composed of cigar retailers and manufacturers.

An ultra bold and satisfyingly flavorful smoke that delivers noticeable notes of spice, coffee, earth, cedar, and a soothing tobacco sweetness. Its deliciously inviting Ecuadorian Habano 2000 maduro wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The Casa Magna XV Anniversary Toro was crafted to celebrate the fifteenth anniversary of the sought-after Casa Maga line. When first released in 2008, the Casa Magna Colorado Robusto not only became the prime example for what a full-bodied cigar should be, it also won Cigar Aficionado's Cigar of the Year. The cigars are handmade at Quesada's Tabacos de Exportación Inc. in the Dominican Republic. This is a limited-edition cigar. Only 3,500 boxes of 15 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

The Casdagli Basilica A Toro is a full-bodied premium cigar with a shaggy foot that exposes the cigar's filler so the smoker can enjoy the filler's flavor before it combines with the binder and wrapper. This flavorful toro sports an enticing natural Dominican Republic Cotui wrapper draped over a Dominican Republic Bonao binder that has been aged for 11 years. These two exquisite leaves cloak a filler composed of Peruvian, Nicaraguan, Dominican Republic and USA tobaccos. This specially curated blend has a balanced sweetness that is accented with notes of vanilla, chocolate, and oak. Handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Kelner Boutique Factory, the Casdagli Basilica A Toro received a 96% “Extraordinary” rating in 2018 from Blind Man's Puff, a well-known cigar website.

This mild cigar offers notes of cedar, oak, toast, and hazelnut with an overall rich creaminess for a satisfying smoking indulgence. It smooth Ecuadorian wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler. The Casdagli Brothers of the Sabre Brave cigar is blended and handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Kelner Boutique Factory. The Brave cigar line is named after Marshal Michel Ney who served under Napoleon. For his valor in battle, Ney was given the moniker of “Le Brave des Braves,” by Napoleon himself.

This smooth maduro has an overall creamy characteristic accompanied by a sweet notes of coffee and cacao. The binder and fillers are smooth, flavorful Dominican tobacco, and these are the same as the original release. The wrapper has been swapped, however, from a Dominican Cotui to an Ecuadorian Habano maduro. The company states this turns the milk chocolate notes fans of the line have come to love into rich, dark chocolate notes. Handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Kelner Boutique factory, the Casdagli Cabinet Selection Rosetta Maduro is an excellent choice as a morning smoke because of its incredible flavor in such a small package.

This medium-strength cigar offers notes of pepper, vanilla, cedar and spice. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper is draped over a Costa Rican binder and a filler composed of Peruvian and Dominican leaves. This exotic blend creates an enjoyable smoking experience. The name for the Daughters of the Wind line was inspired by a famous 16th Century Arab poem. The Casdagli Daughters of the Wind Calico cigar is handmade in Costa Rica.

A medium to full-bodied smoke that offers up peppery, earthy, and woody notes, and a lingering finish . Its Ecuadorian Colorado wrapper covers an Ecuadorian binder and a filler composed of Dominican, Nicaraguan and Ecuadorian leaves (Note: the blend for the Pony Robusto differs from the original blend, which offers a filler made of Dominican and Peruvian leaves). The cigar is capped off with a stylish pigtail. This savory three-nation blend delivers a stimulating but not overpowering smoking experience. The Casdagli Daughters of the Wind The Pony Robusto is handmade at the Tabacos de Costa Rica factory.

Delicious notes of sweetness, nuts, and honey highlight this full-bodied smoke with an irresistible nougat profile. Its smooth mocha Ecuadorian wrapper covers a binder and filler of undisclosed origins. Handmade in Costa Rica, the Casdagli D'Boiss DB-52 offers a flavorful smoking indulgence that can be enjoyed during a coffee break or as an after lunch treat.

A medium to full bodied cigar with a notes of vanilla, cedar, oak, pepper, and smoked wood, which contribute to its deep complexity. A warm tan Dominican wrapper cloaks a Dominican binder and a filler consisting of Dominican, Nicaraguan, Peruvian and USA leaves. This eclectic four-nation blend gives the Casdagli Traditional cigar its distinct flavor profile that makes it a box-worthy cigar. Handmade at the Kelner Boutique Cigar factory in the Dominican Republic.

The Cavalier Genève BII Viso Jalapa is a smooth, medium-bodied cigar that showcases the natural sweetness and aroma of Jalapa tobacco. Handmade at Fábrica Centroamericana de Tabaco in Honduras, this blend features a Nicaraguan Jalapa viso wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and fillers, delivering a balanced and approachable profile familiar to many seasoned smokers.Expect notes of creamy cedar, milk chocolate, toasted bread, and roasted nuts, accented by subtle earthy notes and light baking spices. A gentle pepper on the retrohale adds dimension, while a soft sweetness carries the smoke from start to finish. Strength builds gradually from mild to medium, making it an easy choice for a wide range of palates. Like all Cavalier Genève's cigars, this one is finished with their signature 24-karat edible (and smokeable) gold diamond on the wrapper.

The Cavalier Genève Limited Edition 2026 opens with rich notes of dark chocolate, espresso, cedar, and black pepper, balanced by a natural sweetness that adds depth. Full-flavored and complex, it delivers the bold character enthusiasts have come to expect from Cavaliers annual limited releases.Handmade at Fábrica Centroamericana de Tabaco in Honduras, the Limited Edition 2026 features a Mexican San Andrés wrapper over a Connecticut Habano binder and a blend of Honduran, Nicaraguan, Paraguayan, and Dominican fillers. Produced in limited quantities, this annual release is joined by the return of three fan-favorite Project Broadleaf blends, reinforcing Cavalier Genèves commitment to small-batch craftsmanship and distinctive, full-bodied cigars.

Handmade in Honduras, the Cavalier Geneve Black Series is a medium to full strength cigar. It is box-pressed with a Mexican San Andres wrapper and binder and fillers from Nicaragua. The woody, peppery and toasty notes make it a great cigar to enjoy after dinner.

The Cavalier Genève Limited Edition 2025 marks the eighth year of this annual series, first launched in 2017. Each edition is rolled at Fábrica Centroamericana de Tabaco S.A. in Honduras with a blend that is never repeated and deliberately kept undisclosed. The 2025 release is noted for its medium-bodied profile, finished with a pigtail cap and closed foot. Only 1,948 boxes were produced, maintaining the rarity and craftsmanship that defines Cavalier's Limited Editions.

The Cavalier Genève Limited Edition 2026 opens with rich notes of dark chocolate, espresso, cedar, and black pepper, balanced by a natural sweetness that adds depth. Full-flavored and complex, it delivers the bold character enthusiasts have come to expect from Cavaliers annual limited releases.Handmade at Fábrica Centroamericana de Tabaco in Honduras, the Limited Edition 2026 features a Mexican San Andrés wrapper over a Connecticut Habano binder and a blend of Honduran, Nicaraguan, Paraguayan, and Dominican fillers. Produced in limited quantities, this annual release is joined by the return of three fan-favorite Project Broadleaf blends, reinforcing Cavalier Genèves commitment to small-batch craftsmanship and distinctive, full-bodied cigars.

The Prospektor returns as one of the boldest, character-driven releases from Cavalier Genève. Long appreciated by connoisseurs of niche and boutique cigars, The Prospektor features the same Jalapa and Jamastran wrappers as the original, but swaps the fillers, making for a richer, more assertive profile than what is typical for Cavalier Genève. Expect a darker flavor set built around earth, cocoa, and roasted coffee, layered with black pepper and a subtle underlying sweetness that keeps everything in check. Strength lands comfortably in the medium-to-full range, making it satisfying without being overwhelming.Finished with Cavalier's signature edible gold diamond and produced in limited quantities, the 2025 return of Prospektor is a welcome comeback for fans of a deeper, more expressive profile and rare cigar curiosities.

Celebrate craftsmanship and tradition with the Cavalier Genève Green Jacket 2026, an annual limited-edition inspired by golf's most iconic prize. Handcrafted in Honduras, this 7 x 47 Churchill offers a refined, medium-bodied profile for a long, elegant smoking experience.Wrapped in premium Nicaraguan Jalapa (a first for the Green Jacket line), this cigar strikes a balance between natural sweetness, floral complexity, and smoothness. A Connecticut-seed, shade-grown Honduran binder adds creaminess, while Honduran and Nicaraguan long-fillers deepen the blend with cedar, toasted nuts, and subtle earthiness.Each box offers a unique experience: 10 cigars from the 2026 release plus an exclusive “Muestra 2027” preview cigar, giving aficionados a first taste of next year's blend.

Handmade in Honduras, the Cavalier Geneve White Series is a medium strength cigar that has gold leaf embedded in the Habano wrapper. A connecticut binder and fillers from Paraguay, Nicaragua and Dominican Republic make this sweet and earthy cigar that everyone will enjoy.

A medium-strength cigar with a creamy and nutty profile accented with hints of spice. Its honey-hued Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Habano binder and Nicaraguan filler. The Chateau Real Shade is a wallet-friendly cigar and offers a silky, smooth smoking experience reminiscent of old school, pre-embargo Clear Havana cigars. They are an excellent choice for a morning smoke. Pair it with coffee or espresso. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

The Davidoff Chef's Edition 2025 Toro marks the fifth release in this celebrated series, once again crafted in collaboration with world-class chefs, this year's team of five collectively holding 11 Michelin stars. Wrapped in smooth Ecuadorian leaf over a rich Mexican binder, the blend features Dominican fillers highlighted by a unique hybrid leaf, rare 15-year-aged San Vicente, and piloto tobacco aged for five years using yagua leaves, an old Cuban fermentation style making its Davidoff debut. Limited to just 5,600 boxes for the U.S. market, this cigar is a finely plated course from the Davidoff kitchen of flavor.

This flavorful cigar creates a Cubanesque smoking experience with its spicy, nutty, leathery and peppery notes. Its Dominican binder and filler are cloaked by a toothy Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Davidoff Colorado Claro Double R is the largest vitola in this classic series, and it delivers approximately 90 minutes of pure smoking enjoyment.

A well-balanced cigar that offers notes of spice, nuts, pepper, and leather to create a very Cubanesque profile. Its Dominican binder and filler are cloaked by a toothy Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Davidoff Colorado Claro Special R is a potent yet flavorful smoke that is perfectly sized for when you want to take a brief but pleasurable interlude from the rigors of the day.

The Davidoff Dominicana Robusto is a medium to full bodied, limited-edition cigar that was crafted to commemorate Davidoff's rich history with the Dominican Republic. Its filler is composed of vintage tobaccos from a 2014 harvest. It includes the following leaves: Corojo 99 Seco, Piloto Viso, San Vicente Mejorado Seco, San Vicente Seco, and Yamasa Viso. These specially selected long-filler leaves are then encased in an Ecuadorian Hybrid 151 binder, which is expertly cloaked by a Dominican Hybrid 257 wrapper. This specially cultivated wrapper has a flawless, dark chocolatey color that is simply irresistible. Prior to shipping, the cigars are allowed to mature for 12 months to enhance their flavor profile. The Davidoff Dominicana offers up rich notes of spice, pepper, oak, and cream. It is handmade at the Cigars of Davidoff factory in the Dominican Republic.

They say a classic never goes out of style. It is why Davidoff has brought back the Davidoff Robusto Intenso. Originally released in 2005, this limited-edition premium cigar has returned to capture the hearts, minds, and palates of cigar lovers all over again. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Robusto Intenso LE 2020 features tobaccos from five regions of this Caribbean island nation that are known for producing some of the finest tobacco in the industry. The leaves are then expertly covered by a smooth, red-hued Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. The tobaccos are aged for seven years to allow their intensity, flavor, and aroma to develop. A full-bodied yet balanced cigar, this masterfully crafted cigar delivers a rich complexity of flavors and aroma. The Davidoff Robusto Intenso LE 2020 is part of Davidoff's limited-edition collection only 4,500 boxes of 10 cigars per box were made for U.S. distribution so reserve yours today.

Delivers rich notes of spice, earth, and sweetness. Its oily, dark Ecuadorian maduro wrapper covers a Brazilian binder and filler leaves from the Dominican Republic, Brazil, and Nicaragua. The Davidoff Oro Blanco Toro is a medium strength Dominican puro that is considered one of Davidoff's most exceptional cigar created by master blender Eladio Diaz. It is also their first vintage cigar. Harvested in 2000 – 2001, the tobacco for the Oro Blanco has been carefully aged for 12 years prior to rolling. It is then placed in a special aging room for one year to allow the tobacco's flavors to marry. The Davidoff Oro Blanco is a well-balanced premium cigar with a refined taste and aroma you will remember long after you have smoked it.

The Davidoff Puro Dominicano returns as a full-production offering in the Davidoff Black Band Collection, highlighting the richness of Dominican tobacco. Originally a 2009 limited edition, the line now features a new blend of tobaccos from six Dominican regions, combining a Yamasá wrapper, Martín Garcia binder, and fillers from Mao, Villa González, Piloto, and Navarrete, with a combined leaf age of 32 years.Offered in three sizes, Puro Dominicano cigars are all made at the Davidoff factory in the Dominican Republic. The yellow-accented packaging nods to Dominican amber. This luxurious, fully Dominican smoke reflects Davidoff's craftsmanship and attention to detail, and is surely a great addition to the Black Band Collection.

The Davidoff Robusto Real Especiales 7 LE 2019 is the return of one of the most ambitious and accomplished blends that Davidoff has ever attempted. In 2004, Davidoff released a limited edition cigar called Especiales >, which contained a whopping 7 different types of tobaccos within. Bringing back that initial concept, this new medium-bodied robusto features an Ecuadorian wrapper covering a Dominican binder and a gourmet mix of five fillers from various regions in the Dominican Republic, giving forth a delectably complex and smooth profile that is worth savoring during an occasion as special as it is. Only 4,000 boxes available.

A medium bodied cigar with delightful woody, leather, spicy and sweetness notes. Its Aromatica Dominicana wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and a Criollo Ligero and San Vicente filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Davidoff Royal Release Robusto uses tobaccos that have been specially selected and aged for eight years. The cigars are rolled by eight of Davidoff's most experienced rollers. It takes ten years to produce this exquisite cigar that is best reserved for special occasions.

The Davidoff Year of the Horse 2026 was blended around a rare composition of proprietary hybrid seeds: an Ecuadorian hybrid wrapper, an Ecuadorian hybrid binder, and three Dominican hybrid fillers. According to the Davidoff Group, these individual tobaccos have been aged up to 10 years, totaling a combined 43 years of aging. This marks the first time Davidoff has created a blend made entirely from its own hybrid seed varieties, each developed through a years-long selection process. The release also carries a symbolic connection as Zino Davidoff himself was born in the Year of the Horse. This cigar was designed to reflect the zodiac sign's elegance, vitality, and expressive spirit. While the cigar has not yet debuted, Davidoff describes the profile as sweet and rich, with notes of milk chocolate, roasted hazelnut, and subtle spice. Like many Davidoff Chinese New Year editions, this is a collector-oriented release showcasing the brand's highest level of craftsmanship. Get yours while it's available!

The Eiroa Dark 30th marks three decades of Christian Eiroa's influence on the premium cigar industry, reimagining one of the brand's most celebrated blends for a new generation of smokers. Rich, bold, and full of character, the cigar builds on the foundation of the original Eiroa Dark while introducing new dimensions to the blend.Created to commemorate Eiroa's 30 years in the cigar business, the Eiroa Dark 30th moves beyond the original Honduran puro concept by incorporating tobacco from the company's Colombian farm, including Pinareño tobacco alongside the Corojo varieties that have become synonymous with the Eiroa name. The Master Mason constructs a superb smoking experience by delivering notes of cocoa, sweetness, leather, and cedar.

The Hiram & Solomon Traveling Man Robusto is hand crafted in Nicaragua by Plasencia Cigars. It is a medium bodied stick that features an inviting natural Indonesian wrapper placed over an Indonesian binder, and a filler composed of Brazilian Arapiraca, Dominican, and Nicaraguan Habano tobaccos. This unique four-nation blend delivers a coffee and spicy flavor with a smooth creamy finish.

The Hiram & Solomon Entered Apprentice Robusto is a mild cigar that offers a creamy, silky smoking experience with touches of spice. Its delectable honey-hued Honduran Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Honduran Connecticut Shade binder and filler composed of USA Pennsylvania, Paraguay, and Nicaraguan Habano Ometepe leaves. This medium-bodied cigar offers enticing notes of white pepper accented with escalating hints of cinnamon. Handmade at the Plasencia Cigars factory in Nicaragua, the Hiram & Solomon Entered Apprentice received a 93-Rating from Blind Man's Puff and a 93-Rating from Cigar & Spirits Magazine. Proceeds from the sale of Hiram & Solomon cigars goes to charities such as the Shriners Hospital for Children.

The Hiram & Solomon Fellow Craft Toro is a medium-strength cigar with an award-winning blend. This medium to full-bodied cigar delivers enticing noticeable notes of black pepper, cedar, an eye-popping leathery aroma and an earthy finish. Handmade at the Plasencia Cigars factory in Nicaragua, the Hiram & Solomon Fellow Craft received the #2 spot in Cigar & Spirits Magazine's Boutique Cigar of 2017. Proceeds from the sale of Hiram & Solomon cigars goes to charities such as the Shriners Hospital for Children.

The Hiram & Solomon Shriner Robusto uses tobaccos from five different countries to provide a uniquely international smoking experience. Its smooth, red-hued Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper covers an Indonesian binder and a filler made of Brazilian Arapiraca, Dominican Republic, Nicaraguan Habano Jalapa and Ometepe leaves. This medium bodied stick exudes a floral aroma accompanied by delicious notes of cocoa and cedar with a warm earthy finish. Handmade at the Plasencia Cigars factory in Nicaragua, the Hiram & Solomon Shriner received a 93-Rating from both Blind Man's Puff and Cigar & Spirits Magazine. Proceeds from the sale of Hiram & Solomon cigars goes to charities such as the Shriners Hospital for Children.

The Hiram & Solomon Veiled Prophet Grand Monarch is a long, thick stick that was expertly hand crafted by the best rollers at the Plasencia Cigars factory in Nicaragua. This mild giant offers a sweet cedar aroma accompanied by notes of coffee and caramel with a peppery and earthy finish. The Hiram & Solomon Veiled Prophet received a 94-Rating from Stogie Press and a 93-Rating from Cigars & Spirits Magazine. Proceeds from the sale of Hiram & Solomon cigars goes to charities such as the Shriners Hospital for Children.

A box-pressed, full-bodied cigar that has an earthy and spicy profile. It is a Nicaraguan puro from its wrapper right down to its core. This potent and flavorful cigar offers delicious notes of spice, earth, herbals and sweetness. Its Honduran wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan binder and Aganorsa Leaf and Viso Corojo 2006 fillers. Handmade in Nicaragua. The Illusione Allegria delivers a pleasant and Cubanesque smoking experience.

This medium strength cigar exudes bold and flavorful notes of espresso, pepper, nuts, and touches of hickory. A true Nicaraguan puro that features an oily, red-hued Corojo wrapper. The Illusione ECCJ Robusto Extra is a medium strength cigar that is handmade in Nicaragua. Get ready for a fiery ride because this Nicaraguan puro is packed with tons of spice, but tempered with warm notes of nuts, cream, sweetness, and wood. The ECCJ was created to commemorate the 20th anniversary of Cigar Journal magazine (formerly known as European Cigar Cult Journal). This is a limited release cigar, only 2,000 boxes of 15 cigars per box were made, so order a box today, before theyll gone.

A medium-bodied cigar that will pamper your palate with rich notes of cedar, almonds, white pepper, and a creamy finish. It is an all-Nicaraguan cigar that sports a smooth, natural wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua. The Illusione Fume DAmour cigar is a delicious offering from renowned boutique brand Illusione, and maintains the brand's cherished history of premium, gourmet smokes. The Fume DAmour was awarded the #3 spot in Cigar Aficionados Top 25 Cigars of 2014.

A potent smoke with a deliciously sweet caramel profile accented with notes of spice and an exotic spicy finish. The RB is the first release of the Illusione The Group of Five series. The cigars are handmade by Aganorsa Leaf in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied smoke with chocolatey and earthy notes and a woody aroma. This Nicaraguan puro sports a rustic natural wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua. A medium bodied cigar that delivers notes of sweetness, cocoa, cinnamon, and citrus. When first released and before being acquired by Illusione, its name created much debate as to whether or not it had Cuban tobacco.

A smooth, mild smoke that exudes a warm creaminess accompanied by notes of cocoa, sweetness, cedar, and nuts. This Nicaraguan puro sports a lush verdant Double Claro (aka Candela) wrapper. A flavorful, full-bodied smoke with palate pleasing notes of leather, black cherry, and floral sweetness. This Nicaraguan puro sports a delightful, red-hued wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua. The Illusione cg:4 is well regarded for its consistency and balance.

It was developed in collaboration with Dion Giolito founder of Illusione cigars and marks the first time that Giolito has created a cigar for a celebrity.

This medium bodied cigar offers deep notes of leather, cedar, and cinnamon. Its gorgeous Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and filler. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Illusione Rothchilde CT offers a palate pleasing smoking experience at a wallet-friendly price.

In 2010, Illusione founder Dion Giolito released the first Singulare. It was meant to be an annual small batch limited-edition cigar that was blended from exclusive tobaccos grown in various plantations. The tradition continues. Once lit, this shorty offers up a delicious sweetness with some bold spicy notes and hints of cocoa, fruit, leather, and pepper. The Illusione Singulare Kadosh is handmade in Nicaragua by Aganorsa Leaf.

A potent, full-bodied cigar with a spicy, earthy, and coffee profile tempered by a delicious sweetness. The Origen's blend uses the best components from the Singulare to  create an awesome regular production cigar. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.
