Black pepper, earth, espresso, and dark cocoa drive the profile of the Illusione ULTRA MKULTRA (2026), a powerful Nicaraguan puro that delivers the strength and intensity that made the original release legendary. Despite its bold character, layers of sweetness, cedar, and roasted coffee help keep the blend balanced and engaging.Produced by Illusione, the ULTRA MKULTRA returns in 2026 to mark the 20th anniversary of the original blend. What began as an unexpectedly stronger version of the blend that would become the original MK evolved into one of the most sought-after cigars in the Illusione portfolio. Crafted entirely from Nicaraguan tobaccos, this limited return honors that legacy while bringing back the rich, full-bodied profile that earned the MKULTRA its cult following among experienced smokers.

The “Green Room Selection” concept highlights cigars chosen for their presentation and exclusivity, offering a curated version of one of Joya de Nicaragua's most historic names.

This full-bodied cigar offers deep notes of leather, earth, and spice. Its Nicaraguan Habano wrapper covers a Dominican binder and specially aged Nicaraguan filler leaves. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Joya de Nicaragua Cuatro Cinco was created to celebrate the brand's 45th anniversary.

The Joya de Nicaragua Rosalones Reserva is a value-driven Nicaraguan puro that delivers the rich character and signature flavor profile for which Joya de Nicaragua is known. Handcrafted at the renowned Fábrica de Tabacos Joya de Nicaragua S.A., this regular-production cigar features a Nicaraguan Habano Criollo Colorado wrapper over carefully selected Nicaraguan binder and filler tobaccos.Originally one of Joya de Nicaraguas earliest brands, Rosalones returned after a two-decade hiatus and continues to offer an affordable introduction to Nicaraguas authentic taste. Considered the younger sibling to the classic Joya de Nicaragua Clásico, the Reserva blend provides a medium-bodied smoking experience with consistent earthy notes, natural sweetness, and a rich, well-balanced character from start to finish.Whether youre an everyday smoker looking for exceptional value or exploring the heritage of one of Nicaraguas oldest cigar makers, the Rosalones Reserva delivers authentic Nicaraguan flavor at an approachable price.

An Ecuadorian Connecticut shade wrapper is expertly wound around the Kafie 1901 Connecticut's Honduran binder, which houses fillers from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. Delicately balanced notes of cinnamon and vanilla with a hint of cocoa will greet your taste buds when you light the Kafie 1901 Connecticut Robusto.

A savory, medium bodied cigar with delectable notes of dried fruit, wood, chocolate, and cream. Its Nicaraguan Habano maduro wrapper covers a Cameroon binder and Dominican Andullo, Pennsylvania broadleaf, and Nicaraguan long-filler leaves. The wrapper has been aged for 5 years, which adds to the cigar's complexity. The Dominican Andullo filler leaves enhance the cigar's aroma and flavor profile. The cigars are handmade at the historic La Aurora Cigars factory in the Dominican Republic. The Kafie 1901 DF Maduro's four-nation blend creates an exotic and elegant smoking indulgence that make it a box worthy cigar.

A bold full-bodied cigar that offers savory notes of coffee cream, pepper, earth, dried fruits, and dark chocolate. The cigar's wrapper has been double fermented and aged for 5 years to enhance its rich flavor. The Kafie 1901 San Andres is rich in complexity, and it is one cigar you will want to enjoy time after time so be sure to buy it by the box.

A medium to full-bodied cigar with a nutty, woody, leathery, and sweetness profile. This all-Dominican puro features a smooth, oily Corojo wrapper. The tobaccos used for this tasty cigar were grown in the Cibao Valley of the Dominican Republic, a region known for its excellent tobacco.  The cigars are handmade at the historic La Aurora Cigars factory in the Dominican Republic. The Kafie 1901 L Natural cigar is an excellent choice for fans of Dominican tobacco or those wanting to try the deep flavors and rich aroma of this Caribbean nation's finest tobaccos.

This medium to full-bodied cigar offers deep woody, earthy, leathery, and spicy notes with hints of cocoa and sweetness. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra sun-grown wrapper covers a Dominican binder and Nicaraguan, Peruvian, and Dominican long-filler leaves. The cigars are handmade at the historic La Aurora Cigars factory in the Dominican Republic. The Kafie 1901 Sumatra is well regarded for its rich complexity and unique character.

Cedar, roasted nuts, and a touch of baking spice define the Karen Berger Halftime, delivering a medium-bodied profile with a smooth, balanced character and a clean finish. This limited release from Karen Berger Cigars is crafted in Nicaragua and designed as a versatile, easygoing smoke that fits comfortably into any rotation. Blending quality construction with a straightforward Nicaraguan flavor profile, Halftime offers a dependable, well-rounded option that reflects Karen Berger's focus on consistency and accessibility.

A step up in strength and depth, the Karen Berger Overtime leans into a darker, more assertive profile with notes of black pepper, earth, dark wood, and a touch of cocoa. The smoke builds steadily, offering a fuller experience while maintaining balance and a smooth, structured finish.This release from Karen Berger Cigars expands on the easygoing nature of Halftime with a bolder, more developed blend. Crafted in Nicaragua, Overtime is designed for smokers looking for a richer, longer session that still reflects the brand's focus on consistency and approachable quality.

A flavorful, medium-strength cigar that offers deep notes of spice, coffee, and earth underscored by a soothing tobacco sweetness. Its rustic, dark chocolatey Brazilian maduro wrapper sheaths a Dominican Republic binder and filler composed of Dominican and Nicaraguan leaves. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff 2023 PCA Signature Series cigar is an annual limited-edition, box-pressed toro that features a pigtail at the cap. This is the second PCA exclusive released by Kristoff Cigars. It is available only to retailers who attended the Premium Cigar Association (PCA) annual trade show, which Neptune Cigars is proud to be a member of. Only 1,000 Boxes of 20 cigars were made, so order your box(es) today!

A delicious sweetness accompanied by savory coffee, salty, and earthy notes highlight this medium-strength cigar's profile. Its rustic yet mouthwatering Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper sheathes an Indonesian binder and a Nicaraguan filler. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic. The Kristoff 2024 PCA Signature Series Toro is Kristoff's third PCA exclusive release. It is only available to tobacco shoppes that are members of the Premium Cigar Association (PCA) and attended the Association's annual trade show. This is a limited edition cigar. Only 1,000 boxes of 20 cigars per box were made. So! Order yours today.

Rich notes of oak, earthy cocoa, natural sweetness, and a balanced pepper define the medium-bodied Kristoff PCA Exclusive 2025. Crafted at Tabacalera Von Eicken S.R.L. in the Dominican Republic, it revives the blend of the 2020 edition, offering fans a rare second chance at a blend that was good enough to make twice.

This full-bodied cigar offers spicy, earthy, and woody notes. Its Brazilian maduro wrapper Sumatra binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic, and undisclosed origins. Attaining a hefty 60-ring gauge at its widest point, this masterfully crafted cigar offers a potent yet flavorful smoking experience. The cigar is named after the Chicago address where Glen Case, founder of Kristoff cigars, lived until he turned 21 years of age. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff 685 Woodlawn Perfecto is a limited edition cigar you will not want to miss.

Kristoff Cameroon Churchill cigars are smooth, medium to full bodied and full flavored. This blend creates a pleasant and complex cigar with the creamy, nutty and sweet cedar characteristics of a classic Cameroon.

A mild and flavorful smoke with an inviting creamy, spicy, and vanilla profile. Its natural Ecuadorian shade-grown wrapper surrounds a Nicaraguan Habano binder and a Dominican Habano filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff Connecticut is a delicious treat that pairs well with coffee.

The Kristoff Corojo Limitada is a medium-bodied Dominican cigar with an oily Corojo wrapper surrounding a Dominican binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican fillers. Crafted carefully by hand at the Charles Fairmorn factory in the Dominican Republic, this premium boutique Churchill features both sweet and spicy notes that will leave you and your palate enamored.

This medium bodied cigar offers notes of toasted almond, spice and a sweet finish. Its Cuban-seed Honduran Criollo wrapper covers a Cuban-seed Dominican binder and Cuban-seed Dominican and Nicaraguan fillers. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff Criollo cigar has a covered foot, which accentuates the cigar's rustic look.

A potent cigar delivers notes of sweet molasses, espresso, and chocolate. Its Brazilian maduro wrapper drapes a Honduran binder and filler leaves from Honduras, Nicaragua, and the Dominican Republic. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff GC Signature Series is a Classic Cuban-style cigar that will appeal to smokers who yearn for a traditional smoking experience.

The Kristoff Habano Churchill is a premium cigar that is crafted using the time-tested Entubado method, which allows for an effortless draw. This long, lean, medium-bodied stick features a Brazilian Habano wrapper placed over a Brazilian Sumatra binder and a filler composed of Nicaraguan and Dominican Habano leaves. This three-nation blend delivers notes of nuts, spice and cedar with a long spicy sweet finish. The Kristoff Habano is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium bodied cigar with  a smooth creamy profile and hints of vanilla, honey, sweetness, and earth. Its Nicaraguan Criollo Habano wrapper sheathes a Dominican binder and filler. A flavorful, medium-bodied smoke with savory notes of coffee, hazelnut, spice, and a semi-sweet cocoa bean finish. This is a mesmerizing smoke so be sure to set aside some time to enjoy this long, thick cigar preferably after a hearty dinner or a weekend barbeque.

A full-bodied cigar that delivers notes of espresso, dark chocolate, and tobacco sweetness. This medium bodied cigar offers delicious notes of coffee, cocoa, spice and dark chocolate. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff Maduro is capped with a pigtail at the head, and with its closed foot accentuates the cigar's rustic look.

A potent and flavorful cigar with savory notes of milk chocolate, coffee, spice and hints of black pepper. Its Mexican San Andres wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian Habano binder and a Nicaraguan Habano filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Kristoff San Andres will captivate your palate from first puff to last.

A medium-bodied cigar that delivers delightful notes of cream, nuts, and spice. Its Honduran USA Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Cuban-seed Dominican binder, and a filler made of Cuban-seed Dominican and Cuban-seed Nicaraguan tobaccos. The Kristoff Shade Grown is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Kristoff Sumatra is a medium to full-bodied Dominican cigar with a chestnut-brown Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper on top of a Brazilian binder and premium Nicaraguan and Dominican fillers. Handmade at the Charles Fairmorn factory in the Dominican Republic, this boutique Toro offers a smooth finish containing a gourmet mix of both sweet and spicy notes that will satisfy even the pickiest aficionado.

A potent yet flavorful smoke with a smooth creaminess that delivers delicious notes of baker's chocolate, cardamom, and hints of white pepper, spice, and a warm roast coffee finish. Its tempting Brazilian Arapirca maduro wrapper cloaks an Indonesian binder and a filler made of USA Pennsylvania and Nicaraguan leaves. As its name states, the Kristoff Veinte 20th Anniversary celebrates this popular brand's two decades of crafting enjoyable cigars. Due to its delightful complexity, this cigar is an excellent special occasion smoke, but you can enjoy it whenever and wherever. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium-strength cigar with hints of espresso, sweet mocha, graham cracker, spice, and a creamy finish. Its Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers an Indonesian binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. The Kristoff Vengeance is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A balanced, full-bodied cigar that starts off peppery but easily transitions to unexpected notes of cocoa and fruit. Small Batch stands as the pinnacle of the La Aroma de Cuba line, offering a refined experience that is smooth and flavorful throughout.

To celebrate a century of making great cigars, La Aurora created the La Aurora 100 Anos Robusto which earned the #2 spot in Cigar Aficionado's Top 25 Cigars of the Year in 2004. Another unique treat from the storied Dominican brand, La Aurora!

This is a balanced, medium-bodied cigar with a spicy peppery, toasty, and sweet profile. The blend consists of an Ecuadorian wrapper, a Dominican binder, and Dominican and Nicaraguan filler tobaccos. A complex flavor profile with a strong woodsy base and notes of cinnamon, nuts, and citrus will treat your palate to an unforgettable smoking experience when you light up the La Aurora 115th. The La Aurora 115th Robusto is sold in boxes of 20 cigars per box.

A balanced, full-bodied cigar with a rich complexity that is marked by its woody, spicy, peppery notes underlined by a delicious sweetness and soothing notes of cocoa, coffee, and vanilla. The cigar's inviting wrapper was chosen for its distinct flavor profile and its ability to provide an even burn. The La Aurora 120th Anniversary cigar was created to celebrate this historied brand's 120th anniversary. The cigars are made at La Aurora's cigar factory using tobacco grown on La Aurora's owned and operated farms as well as tobacco from partner farms. A mild to medium cigar with notes of cinnamon, sweetness, red fruits, cocoa, nuts, and a woody aroma. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Dominican binder and long-filler tobaccos. Coming from a storied brand founded in 1903, La Auroras Fuerte Sol blend is the first of the new line and is the beginning of a whole new roster cigars intent on satisfying the United States palate while staying true to the Family Creed.

Contained within this behemoth is a generous helping of Dominican, Nicaraguan, Peruvian and Brazilian fillers, with a Brazilian Mata Fina binder and Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper providing a rich taste containing notes of earth, cedar and leather. Once you decide to set this stick ablaze, make sure youve set aside the next several hours - you will be busy.

Made for boutique legend Caldwell at the Ventura Cigars factory in the Dominican Republic, La Barba Red is the burly brands first official release. A potent and flavorful smoke with delicious notes of sweetness, spice, and coffee with an underlying creaminess. Made of 100% premium Dominican tobacco this exclusive release cigar sports a savory maduro wrapper. Handmade in the Dominican Republic. The cigars are nested in a collectible emerald-green box, which bears a silhouette of cigar crafter Litto Gomez and his first name in script. Apollonia presents a distinct look for La Flor Dominicana, and that's precisely the point. The different appearance matches the dramatically different blend. Created as a 2025 TAA exclusive, this cigar features a Cameroon wrapper over Dominican binder and fillers, a combination unused since the Cameroon Cabinet. This wrapper was selected to emphasize balance as opposed to the strength LFD is typically known for. It was blended by Tony Gomez and named after his mother.The Cameroon wrapper softens the profile, bringing a natural sweetness and light spice, while the Dominican core keeps everything smooth and creamy. Production is limited, with only 1,500 boxes made available exclusively through the Tobacconists' Association of America's group of retailers, giving retailers and aficionados alike a real collectors item from La Flor Dominicana's 2025 lineup.

A potent yet balanced cigar with savory notes of sweetness, spice, and a subtle creaminess. Chinese zodiac releases have become a familiar lane in the premium cigar world, with many brands using the annual cycle to showcase limited blends and distinctive packaging. For 2026, La Galera returns to that space with its own Year of the Horse release, marking a notable moment for the brand as it joins a category often dominated by larger names.La Galera's roots are firmly Dominican, drawing on generations of tobacco growing and blending through the Jochy Blanco family. Known for blends that highlight Dominican character, The Year of the Horse pushes the boundaries a little bit, utilizing a Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper over a Dominican olor binder and four Dominican fillers: criollo 98, olor, pelo de oro, and piloto Cubano seed. That blend gives the cigar a richer, darker edge than a typical Dominican profile. The Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper adds depth and natural sweetness, while the Dominican olor binder keeps everything structured and aromatic. The mix of Criollo 98, Olor, Pelo de Oro, and Piloto Cubano fillers brings balance. Earthy, slightly spicy, and smooth notes work in harmony to create a layered flavor that tastes full without becoming heavy. Pick up this limited edition stick while you can.

The La Palina Silver Label Toro is a full-bodied premium cigar that was created to satisfy this storied brand's fans' demand for a stronger but flavorful stick. This potent but not overwhelming toro uses a Honduran Habano wrapper, a Costa Rican binder, and a hearty mix of Nicaraguan, Honduran, and Costa Rican fillers that provides a bold yet smooth smoking profile. The La Palina Silver Label is handmade in Honduras.

This mild smoke offers notes of leather, nutmeg, and citrus. Its Honduran Connecticut-seed wrapper covers a Mexican San Andres binder and a Dominican Piloto Cubano and Mexican San Andres filler. The La Palina White Label cigar is handmade in Honduras.

The La Rosa De Sandiego Connecticut Robusto is a hefty stick that offers a Cubanesque smoking experience. With its rich complexity of flavors and excellent construction, the La Rosa De Sandiego Habano Robusto recalls the classical Cuban cigars of days gone by. Its reddish, mouthwatering Ecuadorian Habano wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian binder and a filler consisting of Nicaraguan and USA Pennsylvania tobaccos. Once lit, this full-strength, medium to full-bodied stick delivers warm notes of coffee and oak with touches of chocolate. This premium cigar will appeal to the veteran aficionado, but it is a great smoke for novice's who wish to expand their smoking portfolio. The La Rosa De Sandiego Habano is hand crafted by American Caribbean Cigars in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied Honduran puro with a complexity of flavors that will please your palate as well as your wallet. Its savory Criollo maduro wrapper covers a binder and filler made of top-shelf Honduran tobacco. Once rolled, each cigar is encased by an actual tobacco leaf instead of cellophane. The Leaf by Oscar 10th Anniversary Criollo was created to mark this ever popular brand's first decade. The cigars are handmade in Honduras.

The distinctive Leaf by Oscar line of cigars is introducing a lovely Limited-Edition Connecticut Broadleaf blend to its lineup. This hand-rolled full-strength Honduran was produced with just 1,500 boxes. According to the signature style of the line, each cigar is wrapped in a natural tobacco leaf, giving it a distinct look. Under the oily Broadleaf wrapper is a well-packed Honduran filler that repeats the excellence of the regular blends; think lots of smoke, slow burn, and a draw with just enough resistance. Beyond its visual appeal, the Leaf by Oscar line is loved by its smokers for its quality and consistency.

A medium-strength cigar with tantalizing woody, nutty, and peppery notes. Its smooth Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Honduran binder and filler. Instead of cellophane, the Leaf by Oscar Connecticut is sheathed in a rustic-looking tobacco leaf, which you remove to reveal the actual cigar. It is a great morning smoke that will appeal to both the veteran and novice smoker. The cigars are handmade in Honduras.

This medium-strength cigar has a peppery profile accented by woody and nutty notes. Its natural Corojo wrapper covers a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras, the Leaf by Oscar Corojo is a delightful smoke that provides a palate-pleasing smoking experience. Instead of cellophane, the cigar is encased in an actual tobacco leaf, which you remove prior to smoking.

A well-balanced, medium-strength cigar with a spicy, earthy, coffee profile and a toasty aroma. Its savory Nicaraguan maduro wrapper cloaks a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras. Instead of cellophane, the Leaf by Oscar Maduro is cloaked in an actual tobacco leaf, which you remove prior to lighting.

A potent yet flavorful smoke that delivers deep woody, earthy, and peppery notes with refreshing hints of citrus. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper is combined with a Honduran binder and filler. Handmade in Honduras. Instead of cellophane, the Leaf by Oscar Sumatra is sheathed in an actual tobacco leaf, which you remove prior to lighting.

This balanced medium-bodied cigar invites you to unlock your imagination with its complexity of flavors accented by delicious notes of chocolate and hints of spice. Its smooth, reddish Ecuadorian Habano wrapper cloaks an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and a Nicaraguan and Peruvian filler. When developing the blend for The Dreamer, Luciano Meirelles, the CEO and co-founder of Luciano Cigars, wanted to craft a cigar that will allow aficionados to dream up new ideas and make them a reality. The cigars are expertly handmade by Luciano Cigars in Nicaragua. The Luciano The Dream Hermoso No. 4 received an 88 rating from Cigar Insider.

The Luciano Élevé Sublime is crafted in a single vitola and produced in the Dominican Republic at an undisclosed factory. Its blend draws from multiple growing regions, though the specific tobaccos remain undisclosed—allowing the cigar's balance and construction to speak for itself. Released in limited quantities, it also marks one of the first projects developed under Luciano Cigars' new partnership within the Constella Group. Limited production of just 1,420 boxes.

Handmade in Nicaragua at the Luciano Cigars Factory. The Luciano Foreign Affair is a well balanced medium strength cigar with an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, dual binders from Nicaragua and Ecuador and fillers from Costa Rica, Dominican Republic and Nicaragua.

Intricate woody, spicy, earthy, and sweetness notes reveal themselves when you light up this bold yet flavorful cigar. Its mouthwatering Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Sumatra and Habano '92 binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua, Peru, and the Dominican Republic. The Maria Lucia cigar has an overall versatile profile that will easily appeal to both seasoned and novice aficionados. The cigars are artfully handmade by Luciano Cigars in Nicaragua.

Constella Group and Luciano Cigars team up for a new PCA debut with The Machinist, a release built around a deliberately technical blend. The blend uses a Mexican San Andrés viso wrapper, a dual binder of Ecuadorian Sumatra viso and Indonesian Sumatra, and a filler that includes tobacco from Pennsylvania, the Dominican Republic, and South Africa. The goal here is precision; each leaf is selected to play a specific role rather than overpowering the whole.

Luciano's Underrated is a rich, full-bodied maduro that lives up to its name by overdelivering on every draw. Expect bold flavors of dark cocoa, black pepper, and earthy sweetness, all tied together with a smooth, creamy texture that lingers. The blend features a dark Mexican San Andrés wrapper, a sturdy Nicaraguan binder, and a unique filler mix of Connecticut Broadleaf, Ecuadorian HVA, and rare medio tiempo leaves from Pueblo Nuevo, Nicaragua. Created in collaboration with NBA legend Ron Harper, this cigar might not help your jump shot, but itll definitely elevate your lounge game. Handcrafted at Luciano Tabacos S.A. in Nicaragua.

The Macanudo 1968 robusto is a very aromatic stick, with an oily, medium brown Honduran San Agustin wrapper. The fillers are Dominican and Nicaraguan Ometepe leaves; the binder is a Connecticut Habano. With its flawless construction, this is a medium to full bodied Macanudo that is far more complex than the rest of the Macanudo line.

A medium-bodied smoke with a creamy, woody, nutty, and sweetness profile. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper cloaks a Mexican binder and a Mexican and Dominican Piloto Cubano filler. The Macanudo Cafe cigar offers a smooth mellow smoking experience that is perfect as a morning smoke. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Macanudo Cru Royale Robusto is a noble addition to the Macanudo dynasty that offers meticulous construction and exceptional smoothness. This robusto has been developed for the discerning smoker who demands a satisfying medium-bodied smoking experience. Made with Dominican and Nicaraguan viso leaves and Brazilian Mata Fina for an aromatic smoke with a long, clean finish.

Cream, toasted nuts, cedar, and a light touch of pepper define the Macanudo Ecuadorian Shade, offering a smooth, balanced profile with a little more character than a traditional mellow smoke. The finish stays clean and refined, making it a cigar that is very easy to enjoy for seasoned smokers and novices alike.This new release from Macanudo builds on the brand's reputation for approachable flavor while introducing an Ecuadorian Shade wrapper for extra nuance and aroma. Crafted for smokers who enjoy classic smoothness with a modern twist, it brings a fresh flavor to Macanudo's portfolio.

A luxurious smoke that delivers soothing notes of almonds, caramel, and cedar. Its USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper sheaths a Nicaraguan binder and a filler composed of leaves from Nicaragua, Colombia, Dominican Republic, and Spain. The tobaccos in this unique five-nation blend has been aged from 5 to 10 years. The Macanudo Emissary Espana's sophisticated smoking profile makes a great companion to an espresso, cognac, or Single Malt Scotch. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

Featuring rare French tobacco from the Mugron River Valley near Bordeaux, the Macanudo Emissary France is the brand's first cigar to include tobacco from the region. Grown in a Mediterranean climate near the salty Atlantic breeze, this leaf adds a unique character shaped by the region's distinctive terroir of salt and dark berries. The medium-bodied blend is completed with aged tobaccos from four other countries, each matured between four and ten years to deliver a refined, globally inspired smoking experience.

A medium-bodied smoke with soothing notes of vanilla, cedar, nuts, and a hint of fruitiness. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a USA Connecticut Broadleaf binder, and a filler made of Brazilian Mata Fina, Dominican Olor, Dominican Piloto Cubano and Jalapa, Nicaragua leaves. The cigar's binder was aged in French Oak barrels that once contained Flint Knoll's 2019 Royal Appointment Cabernet Sauvignon. The wine left its distinct flavors on the barrels, which was then passed on to the tobacco. Aging the tobacco in these barrels adds a flavorful dimension and complexity to the cigars profile to create a “one-of-a-kind smoking experience.” The Macanudo Estate Reserve Flint Knoll No. 2 cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This mild long corona delivers nutty, creamy and sweetness notes. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Mexican San Andres binder and a Mexican and Dominican Republic Piloto Cubano filler. This smooth and sweet blend will appeal to both the novice as well as the veteran aficionado. The Macanudo Gold Label Shakespeare is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

Carefully crafted in the Dominican Republic under the watchful supervision of cigar master Daniel Nunez, Macanudo Maduro delivers a well-balanced, rich, flavorful smoke with all the smoothness you expect from Macanudo. This corona is sealed in cedar lined aluminium tube which preserves freshness and protects the cigar.

The Macanudo Heritage Nuevo Robusto is a mild cigar that is expertly handcrafted in the Dominican Republic. Its smooth, golden-brown Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper sheaths a Mexican binder and a filler made of tobaccos from the Dominican Republic and Mexico. The Heritage Nuevo will coat your palate with notes of spice, cedar, and nuts and a hint of sweetness. This flavorful smoke goes great with morning coffee.

The Macanudo Heritage Reserve Churchill is a splendid premium cigar made of carefully aged tobacco. Its smooth, tasty Honduran natural wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a filler composed of vintage Honduran and Nicaraguan leaves. Once rolled, the cigar is aged for two years to allow its unique flavor profile to develop. This medium-bodied yet well-balanced stick offers a complexity of flavors with rich notes of cedar, cocoa, wood, and subtle hints of spice. The Macanudo Heritage Reserve is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This mild cigar offers up warm notes of vanilla and wood and an herbal finish. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a Dominican Piloto 94, Nicaraguan and Honduran filler. The wrapper comes from a prized 10-year aged 2010 crop. The leaves for the fillers have been aged three to five years, respectively. From first puff to last, the Macanudo Vintage 2010 clearly exhibits the nuances you will find in a carefully aged cigar. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The pleasant sweetness and aroma of Macanudo Maduro in a small size. They say good things come in small packages! Comes in a box of 10 tins of 10 cigars. This small cigar is well constructed, mild and very satisfying.

A mild to medium-bodied smoke with rich notes of cedar, coffee, and spice. Its USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper drapes a Mexican San Andres binder and a Dominican Republic Piloto Cubano and Mexican filler. The Macanudo Maduro is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A mild to medium-bodied smoke with rich notes of cedar, coffee, and spice. Its USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper drapes a Mexican San Andres binder and a Dominican Republic Piloto Cubano and Mexican filler. The Macanudo Maduro is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This Double Corona is a beautiful, dark, oily cigar with sweet, pronounced flavors. Whilst the wrapper is very dark, the Macanudo Maduro is not a strong cigar due to the mild to medium blend of Dominican and Mexican fillers and Connecticut Shade binder.

A potent, full-bodied cigar with a spicy, earthy, fruity, coffee profile and a hint of sweetness. Its muscular USA Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Brazilian, Nicaraguan, and Dominican Republic filler. The wrapper comes from a 1997 crop, which is considered one of the best grown. The Macanudo Maduro Vintage 1997 offers a balanced smoking experience. Each cigar comes with an eye-catching collectible metal band that serves double duty as a cigar stand. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

Earth, baking spice, cedar, and subtle sweetness lead the profile of the Macanudo Sumatra, delivering a medium-bodied experience with richer texture and more pronounced complexity. A gentle pepper note and woody finish give it structure without overwhelming the palate.This addition to the Macanudo lineup uses a Sumatra wrapper to create a bolder, more expressive take on the brand's traditionally smooth style. Designed for everyday approachability and fuller flavor, it offers a balanced step up for smokers looking to explore beyond the classic Macanudo profile.

A mild cigar with a nutty, creamy profile and a sweet cedar aroma. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Connecticut Habano binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Republic filler. Its exceptional proprietary wrapper comes from a crop that was harvested in 2006. The Macanudo Vintage 2006 offers a balanced smoking experience. Each cigar is adorned with a collectible metal band that serves as a cigar rest. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A mild cigar with a nutty, creamy profile and a sweet cedar aroma. Its USA Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Connecticut Habano binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan and Dominican Republic filler. Its exceptional proprietary wrapper comes from a crop that was harvested in 2006. The Macanudo Vintage 2006 offers a balanced smoking experience. Each cigar is adorned with a collectible metal band that serves as a cigar rest. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

This medium to full-bodied stick has a rich creamy profile coupled with an irresistible tobacco sweetness and hints of spice. Its savory Mexican maduro wrapper covers a Dominican binder and filler. The Matilde Limited Exposure No. 1 Lonsdale is handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A medium bodied smoke with notes of spice, sweetness, floral, and leather. Its Ecuadorian Corojo wrapper covers a Dominican binder, and a Corojo, Criollo '98, Dominican and Havana Vuelta Arriba filler. The Matilde Limited Exposure No. 2 is the second release of the brand's limited exposure series. During certain times throughout the year, Matilde releases a limited edition cigar. Each cigar bears the blend's number and the year it was produced. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Tabacalera La Isla under the supervision of Hostos Quesada (nephew of Manuel Quesada, owner of the world famous Quesada Cigars).

The Matilde Limited Exposure No. 3 is the latest installment in the experimental Limited Exposure series from Matilde Cigars, led by founder José Seijas. Like previous releases in the series, this cigar is produced in small quantities and designed to showcase unique blends and creative concepts that fall outside the company's regular portfolio.Crafted in the Dominican Republic, the Limited Exposure No. 3 allows the blending team room to experiment with different tobaccos and flavor profiles. This blend differs from even the other Limited Exposures. While Matilde blends typically lean heavily Dominican (around 80%, according to Enrique Seijas), No. 3 takes a different approach, built on a 50/50 split of Dominican and Central American tobaccos. The result is a distinctive, limited-production cigar that offers enthusiasts a chance to experience another one-off creation from one of the industry's most respected blenders.

This medium-bodied smoke contains notes of cocoa, espresso, cedar and cream. Its Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper sheathes an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and a Dominican, Nicaraguan and Pennsylvanian filler. The cigar is highly regarded for its consistency and flawless craftsmanship. The Matilde Oscura Toro Bravo is handmade at Tabacalera La Matilde in the Dominican Republic by the legendary Seijas family. The cigar was rated 91 by Cigar Aficionado.

The Matilde Para Jose Seijas is a cigar made in honor of the late Jose A. Seijas. Seijas was known for his innovations at Tabacalera de Garcia and for founding Matilde cigars with his sons. An Ecuadorian wrapper drapes a Dominican Republic binder and filler. The Matilde Para Jose Seijas Toro is handmade in the Dominican Republic at the Tabacalera La Isla. Only 750 boxes of 20 cigars per box were made so order yours today before they are all gone.

This medium-bodied cigar delivers deep notes of cocoa, earth, toast, and citrus. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Dominican binder, and aged Dominican and Nicaraguan filler leaves.  The Matilde Quadrata Robusto is made by the Seijas family at Tabacalera La Matilde in the Dominican Republic. It is the third line released by the company.

This medium bodied cigar offers pleasing notes of sweetness, pepper, leather, and wood. Its Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Dominican binder, and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Matilde Renacer is named after the original Tabacalera La Matilde that dates back to 1876 in Santiago, Dominican Republic. The Matilde Renacer Toro Bravo received an 88 rating from Cigar Insider.

Made at Tabacalera Palma in the Dominican Republic, the Matilde Serena Toro Bravo is brought to you by the esteemed Seijas family, and is the first cigar offered by the boutique brand that is on the lighter end of the spectrum. Featuring a golden-hued Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper that covers a Dominican binder and a gourmet mix of Dominican and Nicaraguan fillers, this mild to medium-bodied toro provides sweet and creamy notes of nuts, oak, hay, and earth through a crisp finish.

A medium-strength cigar that delivers notes of mocha coffee, dried fruits, toast, and an earthy, leathery, and tobacco aroma. Its oily Mexican maduro wrapper covers a Dominican Criollo '98 binder and a Nicaraguan and Dominican Republic filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic, the Matilde Serena Maduro is a well-balanced cigar with a rich complexity that provides a palate pleasing smoking experience.

A medium-strength smoke with rich woody, earthy, and coffee notes accompanied by a delectable sweetness. Its rustic, reddish Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed Colorado wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a filler made of Dominican, Nicaraguan, Peruvian tobacco. The filler leaves from Peru add a distinct flavor and aroma to the smoking experience. The Matilde Special Edition cigar was handmade in the Dominican Republic.

A full-strength yet flavorful cigar that offers delicious notes of cocoa with touches of leather, sweetness, and spice. Its imposing Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper sheaths an Ecuadorian Habano binder and Nicaraguan filler. The blend was developed by Joel and Edel Gomez-Sanchez, third-generation cigar crafters and Micallef Cigar's exclusive blenders. The cigars are handmade at the Micallef Cigars factory in Nicaragua. The Micallef Black is known for delivering a smooth smoking indulgence that packs a punch, and it is available at a wallet-pleasing price.

A delicious creaminess with hints of spice add complexity to this medium-strength cigar's overall sweetness. Its Mexican San Andres Sumatra wrapper covers an Ecuadorian Habano binder and filler leaves from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. The Micallef Blue is an excellent smoke offered at an appealing price. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic.

The Micallef Color Blend Bundles from Micallef Cigars open with a straightforward mix of earth, gentle spice, and soft natural sweetness, settling into a balanced, medium-bodied profile that stays consistent from start to finish. The character is approachable but still layered enough to keep each draw interesting, with a clean, steady finish.These cigars are built using a mixed long and short fillers (a Cuban sandwich), combining select tobaccos from the Color Series production runs. Rolled in Estelí, Nicaragua, they use a Sumatra wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder, offering a practical, everyday expression of the brand's core quality without overcomplicating the experience.

The Micallef Color Blend Bundles from Micallef Cigars open with a straightforward mix of earth, gentle spice, and soft natural sweetness, settling into a balanced, medium-bodied profile that stays consistent from start to finish. The character is approachable but still layered enough to keep each draw interesting, with a clean, steady finish.These cigars are built using a mixed long and short fillers (a Cuban sandwich), combining select tobaccos from the Color Series production runs. Rolled in Estelí, Nicaragua, they use a Sumatra wrapper over a Nicaraguan binder, offering a practical, everyday expression of the brand's core quality without overcomplicating the experience.

A mild smoke with a buttery profile and notes of spice and earth. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers an aged Nicaraguan Habano binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican long filler leaves. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Micallef Connecticut offers a crisp, mellow smoking experience that is perfect any time of day.

This medium bodied cigar offers deep notes of cedar, earth, leather, and spice. Its Mexican San Andres Sumatra wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian Habano binder and aged Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Panamanian long filler leaves. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Micallef Experiencia is known for its traditional look, feel, and taste that will appeal to the contemporary aficionado.

A full-bodied smoke with smooth notes of cedar, coffee, earth, and nuts. Its flawless Ecuadorian Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and select Dominican, Honduran, and Nicaraguan filler leaves. Expertly hand crafted in Nicaragua, the Micallef Gomez Sanchez Leyenda is considered master blender Don Pedro Gomezs proudest achievement.

The Micallef Green opens with layered notes of dried fruit, spice, cocoa, and coffee, showcasing a Brazilian Mata Fina wrapper over a San Andrés Negro binder with Dominican, Mexican, and Nicaraguan fillers. This balanced profile expands Micallef's Color Series, crafted to provide everyday smokers with accessible pricing, reliable construction, and the quality expected from the brand's commitment to tradition and consistency.

A medium bodied, box-pressed cigar with an irresistible sweet and spicy profile. Its Nicaraguan Habano wrapper drapes an Ecuadorian Sumatra binder and long-filler leaves from Nicaragua and Honduras. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Micallef Herencia Habano uses tobaccos that have been carefully aged for four (4) years to create a memorable smoking experience.

A medium bodied cigar that delivers notes of spice, cedar, cinnamon, leather and an overall creaminess. Its Mexican San Andres Habano wrapper covers a Sumatran binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican filler. The tobaccos for the Micallef Migdalia have been perfectly aged for 4 years. After it has been rolled, the Migdalia is aged for one more year to ensure it optimizes its distinct flavor profile. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied smoke with a warm woody profile accented by sweetness and fruity notes. Its oily, Mexican San Andres Habano wrapper is aged for 4 years before it is applied to a four-year old Sumatra binder and four-year old Dominican and Nicaraguan filler leaves. The Micallef Migdalia Special Edition Corona was created in honor of International Women's Day (which is celebrated annually on March 8th), and it pays tribute to the women who have made a great impact in all areas of life especially in the cigar industry. The cigar itself is named after Migdalia Sanchez who is the matriarch of the Gomez-Sanchez family, which is Micallef Cigars' manufacturing partner. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

Sweet spice, cocoa, leather, and cedar lead the charge in the Micallef Purple, delivered through a rich, creamy smoke that's both smooth and satisfying. This regular production cigar features a Mexican San Andrés Sumatra wrapper, a bold broadleaf binder, and a filler blend from the Dominican Republic, Mexico, and Nicaragua. Handcrafted at Micallef's own Nicaraguan factory, it proves that yummy flavors and quality construction don't have to come with a premium price tag.

Initially intended to be the perfect after-dinner smoke, the Micallef Reata Churchill is named after the Reata, Micallef's fine-dining restaurant located in downtown Fort Worth, Texas. Hailing from the Gomez Sanchez factory in Esteli, this mild-bodied Nicaraguan churchill features a somewhat rare Mexican San Andres Claro wrapper, which offers a lighter experience than its popular maduro cousin. No need to save this one for strictly after dinner - the Micallef Reata is easy to enjoy at ANY time of day!

A medium to full-bodied cigar with a spicy and earthy profile underscored by chocolatey, leathery, woody, and molasses notes. Its Mexican San Andres Habano wrapper drapes a Pennsylvania Broadleaf binder and a Nicaraguan and Mexican filler. The pairing of the wrapper and binder contribute to the cigar's enticing spiciness and earthiness. The Micallef Red is handmade in Nicaragua.

A medium bodied cigar that offers deeps notes of oak, leather, fruit, and sweet peppers. Its Habano wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and a filler made of Peruvian, Honduran, and Dominican leaves. The tobaccos have been aged for 8 years and gives this exceptional cigar its sophistication and complexity. The Micallef Reserva Privada is handmade by the Gomez Sanchez family in Nicaragua.

A budget-friendly, mild cigar that delivers notes of cedar, leather, nuts, and pepper. Its Mexican San Andres wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Dominican, Nicaraguan, and Peruvian filler. The Micallef Torcedores offers a smooth and flavorful smoking experience that's perfect during a round of golf or at a weekend BBQ. The cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

The Micallef White marks a new direction for Micallef Cigars, introducing a more approachable, mellow-leaning profile to the portfolio. Blended in Nicaragua, the cigar features an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and fillers from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic, positioning it as a smoother counterpoint to some of the brand's richer, fuller-bodied offerings.Designed to emphasize balance and refinement, Micallef White delivers a creamy, medium-bodied experience centered on cedar, light toast, and subtle sweetness, with a gentle touch of pepper in the background. The construction aims for an even burn and easy draw, making it a versatile option for smokers who prefer a softer, more refined expression.

To commemorate a decade of excellence in the industry, My Father has triumphantly released the My Father 10th Anniversary Limited Edition 2018. Presented elegantly in individual wooden coffins, these medium to full-bodied Nicaraguan beauties carry a flawless Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper on top of a Nicaraguan binder and top-shelf Nicaraguan filler. With the expert construction and consistency expected from My Father, along with the booming flavor and complexity the 10 year old brand has become known for, this is set to be an anniversary you will never forget.

The My Father Blue cigar delivers a earthy baseline with cocoa, cedar, and natural sweetness in a rich, balanced profile. It features a Connecticut Broadleaf Rosado wrapper over a Honduran binder and a blend of Corojo and Criollo fillers, all harvested from the García family's Finca La Opulencia, their first farm in Honduras. As the first My Father cigar made entirely in their Honduran factory using their own Honduran-grown tobaccos, Blue marks a bold new chapter for the brand.

This mild bodied cigar provides a smooth, creamy experience accented with earthy, woody, and peppery notes. Its Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Nicaraguan Corojo binder and a Nicaraguan Criollo and Habano filler. Handmade in Nicaragua. The My Father Connecticut is a great anytime, anywhere cigar that will please both the veteran as well as the novice smoker.

A full-bodied smoke with delicious notes of cedar, nuts, honey, and spice. Its Habano 2000 wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and select Nicaraguan filler leaves grown by the Garcia family. The My Father El Centurion H2KCT is expertly made by acclaimed master blender Jose “Pepin” Garcia at his My Father Cigars factory in Esteli, Nicaragua.

Notes of chocolate, pepper, and citrus combine to give this medium bodied cigar its rich complexity. Its Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan Criollo 98 binder and Nicaraguan filler that includes the rare Pelo de Oro tobacco. Jose “Pepin” Garcia and his son Jaime developed the blend for the My Father Garcia & Garcia cigar, which is handmade in Nicaragua.

Notes of chocolate, pepper, and citrus combine to give this medium bodied cigar its rich complexity. Its Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan Criollo 98 binder and Nicaraguan filler that includes the rare Pelo de Oro tobacco. Jose “Pepin” Garcia and his son Jaime developed the blend for the My Father Garcia & Garcia cigar, which is handmade in Nicaragua.

Spice, black pepper, dark chocolate, leather, and espresso beans combine to create a memorable medium-bodied smoking experience. Its reddish Ecuadorian Habano wrapper sheaths a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The My Father La Gran Oferta is handmade in Nicaragua.

Pepper, cedar, earth, and roasted coffee lead the profile of the My Father La Lealtad, backed by a natural sweetness from the Honduran tobacco and a long, balanced finish. Medium-to-full-bodied, it delivers the rich flavor seasoned smokers expect from the Garcia family.This new release from My Father Cigars is named after the Spanish word for “loyalty,” honoring the relationships and values that helped build the company's legacy. This cigar is crafted in My Father's new Honduran factory, using a warm Ecuadorian sun-grown over Honduran binder and fillers. La Lealtad adds a more medium-bodied take to My Father's Honduran production line.

A potent yet flavorful cigar with a spicy, creamy profile and notes of pepper, leather, and cocoa. Its Mexican San Andres wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and Nicaraguan Cuban-seed long-filler leaves. The My Father La Opulencia is handmade in Nicaragua.

The My Father La Promesa Lancero is a premium long panatela that promises to delight even the most discerning cigar aficionado. Beautifully handmade in Nicaragua, the La Promesa features a dark, rosado Ecuadorian Habano wrapper that is expertly draped over a binder and filler made of Nicaragua's finest tobaccos. The My Father La Promesa is a medium-strength stick that offers up a perfectly balanced flavor profile that is composed of pepper, leather, and cream.

A bold and flavorful cigar that offers a tangy smoking indulgence tempered by notes of cocoa and cedar. This peppery Nicaraguan puro sports an oily, dark Habano wrapper. The My Father Le Bijou 1922 is handmade in Nicaragua. My Father Le Bijou 1922 Petit Robusto received an 89 from Cigar Aficionado and Cigar Insider.

This full-bodied cigar is packed with notes of spice, nuts, chocolate, cedar, and a warm leathery aroma. Its Habano-Rosado wrapper covers a binder and filler made of specially selected Nicaraguan tobaccos. Handmade in Nicaragua, this savory long, lean cigar offers a hearty, meaty smoking indulgence that will appeal to the seasoned aficionado. The My Father No. 4 Lancero received a 94 rating from Cigar Aficionado.

This full-bodied cigar is packed with notes of spice, nuts, chocolate, cedar, and a warm leathery aroma. Its Habano-Rosado wrapper covers a binder and filler made of specially selected Nicaraguan tobaccos. Handmade in Nicaragua, this tasty toro offers a hearty, meaty smoking indulgence that will appeal to the seasoned aficionado. The My Father No. 3 Crema received a 93 rating from Cigar Aficionado  and Cigar Insider.

This full-bodied cigar is packed with notes of spice, nuts, chocolate, cedar, and a warm leathery aroma. Its Habano-Rosado wrapper covers a binder and filler made of specially selected Nicaraguan tobaccos. Handmade in Nicaragua, The My Father No. 6 Toro Gordo offers a hearty, meaty smoking indulgence that will appeal to the seasoned aficionado.

A medium to full-bodied smoke with deep notes of wood, leather, and spice. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The My Father The Judge cigars are handmade in Nicaragua.

The Nat Sherman Epoca Breva is a mild bodied corona that is hand crafted in the Dominican Republic at Manufactura de Tabacos (MATASA) factory, which is owned by Quesada Cigars. Its smooth Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper sheaths a Dominican binder and a filler composed of premium tobacco from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. The Nat Sherman Epoca is a re-engineered version of the original Epoca blend, which was rolled in New York and made entirely of Cuban tobacco back in the early part of the twentieth century. This newer blend was created to pay tribute to the original and delivers a smooth creamy smoking experience with an invigorating finish.

The Nat Sherman Metropolitan Maduro Petite is a medium bodied small panatela that is handmade in Honduras. Its savory dark chocolatey USA Connecticut Broadleaf covers a Honduran binder and filler and delivers a rich and flavorful smoke with hints of sweetness and earthy notes. The Nat Sherman Metropolitan Maduro is a very humidor worthy cigar you will want to add to your regular rotation.

The Nat Sherman Timeless 2019 Limited Edition Toro is a medium-strength premium that is handmade in the Dominican Republic. The Timeless 2019 Limited Edition is only available through retailers who are member of the Tobacconists Association of America (TAA), which is an organization that is composed of approximately 80 retailers and 40 cigar manufacturers. The Nat Sherman Timeless 2019 Limited Edition sports a reddish Dominican wrapper that cloaks a Dominican binder and a filler made of premium tobaccos from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic.

The Timeless Supreme 749 is a premium Churchill that was specially crafted to please Nat Shermans loyal customers. A medium strength cigar, the Supreme is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro that is hand crafted in the world famous Plasencia Cigars factory. Medium-bodied, the Supremes delicious coffee, cocoa, and chocolate profile make it a morning or after-dinner smoke.

Nat Sherman needs no introduction to the seasoned cigar smoker, as the renowned New York brand has proven its brilliance time and time again over the decades. The Nat Sherman Timeless Prestige No.5 is a glowing example of just one of these boutique masterpieces, utilizing a textbook Honduran wrapper covering a Dominican binder and Nicaraguan and Dominican fillers that lead to a delectable blend worthy of the finest of humidors. This medium-bodied petit corona will quench your palate with deep notes of espresso, roasted nuts, and sweet cedar.

The Nat Sherman Timeless Sterling Churchill is expertly hand crafted in the Dominican Republic. This medium bodied premium cigar sports a smooth light-tan Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper that covers a binder and filler composed of well-aged Dominican tobacco. Its specially selected blend offers an ultra-creamy smoking experience punctuated with peppery, salty, and nutty notes. The Timeless Sterling is one classic stick you will want to smoke time after time so be sure to order it by the box.

The Timeless Supreme 546 is a premium cigar that was specially crafted to please Nat Shermans loyal customers. A medium strength cigar, the Supreme is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro that is hand crafted in the world famous Plasencia Cigars factory. Medium-bodied, the Supremes delicious coffee, cocoa, and chocolate profile make it a morning or after-dinner smoke.

A mild, coffee-infused cigar that offers tasty notes of vanilla bean and cream. Its Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Nicaraguan binder and long-filler leaves from Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic. Handmade by Oliva Cigars in the Dominican Republic, the NUb Nuance Single Roast offers a sweet and delicious way to start your day.

This flavor-infused, medium bodied cigar offers a delectable creamy milk chocolatey flavor. Its Sumatra wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and long-filler leaves from the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua. Handmade by Oliva Cigars in the Dominican Republic, the NUb Double Roast is an excellent choice for a morning smoke or as an afternoon delight.

A full-bodied smoke with a woody, spicy and sweet profile, and a nutty finish. Its Habano Colorado maduro wrapper sheaths a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The NUb Habano is handmade in Nicaragua. The crafters of the NUb line realized that at 4 inches in length and between 58 and 66 rings, the Nub delivered almost instantaneous flavor upon ignition yet smoked for a similar duration (average 1 hour) as other cigars that, at least visually, appear almost double the size.

A medium bodied flavor-infused cigar with creamy notes of dark chocolate and espresso. Its Sumatra wrapper covers a Nicaraguan binder and long-filler leaves from the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua. Handmade by Oliva Cigars in the Dominican Republic, the Nub Nuance Triple Roast's irresistible sweetness will satisfy novice as well as seasoned cigar lovers.

A flavorful and potent smoke with a spicy, earthy, and tobacco sweetness profile. A chocolate-brown USA Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper covers a binder and long-filler leaves from Nicaragua. The third entry into a series of special artisan blends, the Oliva Master Blends 3 is a complex premium cigar blended to showcase the richest and most flavorful Broadleaf wrappers and Nicaraguan ligero fillers available on the Oliva farm. The Oliva Master Blends 3 Robusto received a 92 rating from Cigar Aficionado.

The Onyx Churchill is made of a beautiful dark, oily maduro leaf wrapped around an intriguing blend made from a host of countries. A critical success since its debut, the rich and spicy Onyx Reserve was rated 94 by Cigar Insider, one of the highest ratings in the history of the magazine.

The Onyx Robusto are box pressed to give them their classic square shape. Its a beautiful dark, oily maduro leaf wrapped around an intriguing blend made from a host of countries. A critical success since its debut, the rich and spicy Onyx Reserve was rated 94 by Cigar Insider, one of the highest ratings in the history of the magazine.

The Onyx Toro are box pressed to give them their classic square shape. Its a beautiful dark, oily maduro leaf wrapped around an intriguing blend made from a host of countries. A critical success since its debut, the rich and spicy Onyx Reserve was rated 94 by Cigar Insider, one of the highest ratings in the history of the magazine.

The Oscar Valladares Ciseron 2018 Black is named after the famed Honduran artist Elmer Ciseron Bautista. A rich, medium-bodied toro, the Ciseron Black features a Sun Grown Ecuadorian wrapper that is artfully draped over a binder and filler made of premium Nicaraguan tobacco. The Oscar Valladares Colaboraciones series brings together a trio of blends developed in partnership with two major titans: E.P. Carrillo and Oliva, alongside Oscar Valladares' own factory. Each cigar in the project reflects the style and influence of its collaborator, resulting in three distinct expressions built around the same 6 x 54 toro format. Produced in limited quantities, each blend features a unique wrapper and composition. Carillo's blend features a U.S.-grown Connecticut Habano wrapper draped over a Sumatra binder, with a balanced blend of Honduran and Nicaraguan fillers at its core. The goal: to highlight how different factories and blending philosophies can shape the final product. With just 1,500 boxes per blend, Colaboraciones stands as a limited small-batch release that emphasizes collaboration, contrast, and craftsmanship.

The Oscar Valladares Colaboraciones series brings together a trio of blends developed in partnership with two major titans: E.P. Carrillo and Oliva, alongside Oscar Valladares' own factory. Each cigar in the project reflects the style and influence of its collaborator, resulting in three distinct expressions built around the same 6 x 54 toro format. With just 1,500 boxes per blend, Colaboraciones stands as a limited small-batch release that emphasizes collaboration, contrast, and craftsmanship.

The Oscar Valladares Colaboraciones series brings together a trio of blends developed in partnership with two major titans: E.P. Carrillo and Oliva, alongside Oscar Valladares' own factory. Each cigar in the project reflects the style and influence of its collaborator, resulting in three distinct expressions built around the same 6 x 54 toro format. Produced in limited quantities, each blend features a unique wrapper and composition. Rounding out the trio is a standout from Oscar Valladares himself, crafted at his own factory in Danlí, Honduras. With just 1,500 boxes per blend, Colaboraciones stands as a limited small-batch release that emphasizes collaboration, contrast, and craftsmanship.

A medium bodied cigar with a creamy profile accented with spicy, earthy, and sweet notes. Its light-tan Honduran Connecticut Shade wrapper covers a Mexican binder and a Honduran filler. The Oscar Valladares Heaven and Hell Claro cigar offers a smooth and delicious smoking experience that is just heavenly. The cigars are handmade at the Oscar Valladares Tobacco & Co. factory in Danli, Honduras.

This medium bodied smoke offers notes of spice, earth, and sweetness. Its savory Mexican wrapper covers a Honduran binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan, and Dominican Republic filler. The foot is exposed so you can enjoy the filler leaves' flavors before they blend with the wrapper. The cigars are handmade in Honduras. The Oscar Valladares McFly was inspired by the main character from the popular “Back to the Future” movie.

A mild, delicious cigar made by Oscar Valladares, a well-known cigar crafter, and offered at a wallet-friendly bundle price! It doesn't get any better than that. The Plan B Connecticut sports an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper draped over a Honduran binder that's packed with short and long-filler leaves from Honduras and Nicaragua. Hand rolled in Honduras.

A medium-strength cigar made by Oscar Valladares, a well-known cigar crafter, and offered at a wallet-friendly bundle price! It doesn't get any better than that. The Plan B Habano sports a reddish Corojo Habano Colorado wrapper draped over a Honduran binder that's packed with short and long-filler leaves from Honduras and Nicaragua. Hand rolled in Honduras.

This savory medium-strength cigar is the creation of Oscar Valladares, a well-known cigar crafter, and is available at a budget-please price. It's the ideal everyday cigar! The Plan B Maduro sports a dark chocolatey Maduro wrapper placed over a Honduran binder and stuffed with short and long-filler leaves from Honduras and Nicaragua. Hand rolled in Honduras.

This mild cigar's creamy profile is accented with spicy and peppery notes. Its Honduran Connecticut Shade wrapper drapes a Honduran binder and a Dominican Republic, Nicaraguan, and Honduran filler. The cigars are handmade in Honduras. The Super Fly Connecticut offers a cool Seventies vibe, and it is a follow-up to Valladares' popular Super Fly Maduro.

A medium to full-strength cigar that delivers notes of vanilla, chocolate, cocoa, and leather. Its Mexican San Andres maduro wrapper surrounds a Honduran binder and a Honduran, Nicaraguan, and Dominican Republic filler. The Oscar Valladares Super Fly is handmade in Danli, Honduras. The brand was inspired by the ultra-hip Seventies movie that goes by the same name.

A smooth, medium-bodied cigar with a creamy profile accompanied by notes of spice, earth, coffee, and a touch of sweetness. Its Honduran and Nicaraguan filler and Honduran binder is cloaked in a Connecticut Shade wrapper. To protect the wrapper, the cigar is dressed in an actual candela (green) tobacco leaf, which is to be removed prior to smoking. The Oscar Connecticut is the third release of the ever popular The Oscar series, which was first introduced in 2016. The cigars are expertly handmade at Oscar Valladares' own factory in Danli, Honduras.

A  medium to full-bodied cigar with a warm vanilla flavor accented with floral, cedar, and coffee notes and a soothing cocoa aroma. This Honduran puro sports a rustic natural wrapper. It is an excellent example of the fine tobacco that is grown in this Central American country. Oscar Valladares Wild Hunter Oscuro is handmade at the Oscar Valladares factory in Danli, Honduras.

A medium strength cigar with a warm creamy profile highlighted with earthy, spicy, and leathery notes and a pleasant floral finish. Made of 100% premium Nicaraguan tobacco from filler to wrapper. The Padilla Miami 8 & 11 is named after the location where the cigar is made, which is on 8th street and 11th avenue in Miami, Florida at the famed El Titan de Bronze factory. It is a re-creation of the original cigar, which was first release in 2005.
Made with tobaccos aged at least 5 years, this box pressed Nicaraguan maduro offers the palate a long toasty finish and complex full-bodied flavor.

These Premium Handmade long filler cigars are cured, aged and blended with vintage leaves of sun-grown tobacco. Their aroma, taste and consistency are guaranteed by the traditional Cuban Cigar making process that Padron sets as its standard.  This torpedo recieved a 91 from Cigar Aficionado in October of 2008.

Handmade in Nicaragua the Padron 60th Anniversary Maduro is a nicaraguan puro. This full strength cigar was created as a limited edition to commemorate Padron's 60th anniversary so get yours while you can.

The Padron TAA Black No. 89 is a cigar available exclusively through Tobacconists Association of America (TAA) retailers. Offered in only one size (6 x 46), this dark and oily full-bodied maduro will not disappoint. With a blend described as being somewhere between the Padron 1964 Anniversary and Padron 1926 Series, the TAA Black No. 89 is rich and complex. The original idea for this cigar started back in 2016 as a commemoration for Jose Orlando Padrons 89th birthday. Now you can celebrate his legacy once again with this limited edition release

The Padron Damaso delivers a creamy, mellow profile with notes of sweet cream, cedar, toasted nuts, and gentle baking spice, wrapped in a smooth Ecuadorian Connecticut leaf. Unlike the fuller-bodied Padróns, this one leans mild to medium in strength, offering a refined and approachable experience without sacrificing depth. It's a Connecticut cigar built with the same iconic Padrón quality, meticulous construction, flawless draw, and consistent performance in every puff.

The 45 Years Family Reserve is an impressive cigar that feels firm to the touch yet it has an impeccable draw that delivers a spicy, full bodied flavor. This toro uses 10-year old tobaccos and is nicknamed The Little Hammer,  a reference to Jose Padrons humble beginnings as a carpenter in Miami after his exile from Cuba. Production of this cigar is limited to 15,000 sticks. Rated 94 by Cigar Aficionado and 2009s Cigar of the Year.

These medium-to full-bodied, long-filler toro cigars are wrapped in sun-grown habano tobacco that is aged for a minimum of two-and-one-half years. Their exceptional aroma and taste is guaranteed by the traditional Cuban Cigar making process that Padron sets as its standard.

The Padron 1964 Anniversary Hermoso Natural is an integral part of the esteemed brands flagship 1964 Anniversary line, offering a perfect balance of superb quality and utmost value. This golden-hued Nicaraguan puro is simply exquisite, with a texture that is 100% exclusively Padron. Delivering a complex, medium-bodied profile containing notes of cedar, coffee, and roasted nuts, this short and stout robusto has a toasty cinnamon finish with an ideal pinch of white pepper. An extraordinary smoke that is absolutely mandatory for every humidor.

A medium strength cigar that exudes luxurious notes of almonds, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cedar. This Nicaraguan puro features a smooth natural wrapper that telegraphs its rich complexity. Handmade in Nicaragua, the Padron 50th Anniversary Natural cigar was crafted to commemorate the brand's five decades of crafting some of the finest cigars in the world.

These Premium Handmade long filler cigars are cured, aged and blended with vintage leaves of sun-grown tobacco. Their aroma, taste and consistency are guaranteed by the traditional Cuban Cigar making process that Padron sets as its standard.  This robusto was rated 88 by Cigar Aficionado in December of 2005.

The Patoro Brasil Belicoso is a medium strength torpedo that sports an oily, Brazilian wrapper placed over a binder and filler made of premium tobacco from the Dominican Republic. This delightful blend creates a wonderfully balanced smoking experience with its warm notes of cream, coffee, pepper and accented with hints of floral and citrus. The Patoro Brasil Belicoso is handmade at the Augusto Reyes cigar factory in the Dominican Republic.

Made in the Dominican Republic at the Augusto Reyes factory, the Patoro Churchill is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional yet ambitious blend. Composed of a golden Brazilian wrapper on top of a Dominican binder and premium Dominican fillers, this medium-bodied churchill is more than ready to impress palates everywhere with its smooth, creamy notes of cedar and nuts throughout a crisp, toasty finish.

Made in the Dominican Republic at the Augusto Reyes factory, the Patoro Corona is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional yet ambitious blend. Composed of a golden Brazilian wrapper on top of a Dominican binder and premium Dominican fillers, this medium-bodied corona is more than ready to impress palates everywhere with its smooth, creamy notes of cedar and nuts throughout a crisp, toasty finish.

The Patoro Cuvée Royale XXV opens with refined notes of cedar, cream, roasted nuts, and subtle spice, delivering an elegant and balanced profile that has become a signature of the brand. Natural tobacco sweetness and smooth Dominican character bring depth to the experience, creating a sophisticated smoke that rewards a slower pace.Created to celebrate Patoro's 25th anniversary, the Cuvée Royale XXV is a Dominican puro crafted with aged tobaccos and offered as a limited release. Produced in just 600 boxes worldwide, with only half allocated to the U.S. market, this special edition reflects the brand's dedication to premium Dominican tobacco and meticulous blending. For fans of Patoro's refined style, this release carries the same graceful complexity that makes the brand's most celebrated cigars stand out.

Blended by renowned cigar guru Augusto Reyes, the Patoro Gran Anejo Reserva Toro is a medium-bodied premium cigar hailing from the Dominican Republic. Utilizing a gorgeous Ecuadorian Habano wrapper on top of high-grade Dominican binder and filler, this tasty toro is smooth yet complex, providing a spicy, woody profile only achievable by one of the undisputed masters of tobacco

Made in the Dominican Republic at the Augusto Reyes factory, the Patoro Robusto is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional yet ambitious blend. Composed of a golden Brazilian wrapper on top of a Dominican binder and premium Dominican fillers, this medium-bodied robusto is more than ready to impress palates everywhere with its smooth, creamy notes of cedar and nuts throughout a crisp, toasty finish.

This smooth medium-bodied cigar has a creamy profile and offers notes of cedar and nuts and a crisp, toasty finish. Its Brazilian wrapper cloaks a Dominican binder and premium Dominican filler leaves. Handmade at the Augusto Reyes factory in the Dominican Republic, the Patoro Serie P cigar is a small-batch offering that uses Cuban-seed tobaccos from the Santiago Valley to provide a traditional smoking experience.

The Patoro VA XO Extra Salomones is a medium bodied perfecto that is expertly hand crafted at Augusto Reyes' De Los Reyes Cigars factory in the Dominican Republic. The Patoro brand is the creation of Patrik Jonas Martin, who previously served 13 years as a product manager and brand ambassador for the Oettinger Davidoff Group. The Patoro VA XO is an all Dominican puro from its alluring Colorado wrapper right down to its filler. All of the tobacco for this exquisite cigar has been aged between 9 to 12 years. It has a warm woodsy aroma and delivers peppery and citrus notes. The Patoro VA XO Extra Salomones is a very limited-release cigar, so be sure to order yours today.

When a boutique brand owner steps away from the executive desk and back to the rolling table, you know the resulting blend is going to be something legendary. PDR El Vinyet is a small-batch, annual release born directly from the passion of PDR Cigars' founder and Master Blender, Abe Flores. To guarantee absolute perfection in airflow and construction, Flores personally hand-bunched the initial production run at the PDR Factory in Tamboril, Dominican Republic.El Vinyet is a multi-national blend built for smokers who appreciate nuance, depth, and unwavering complexity. The core features a robust filler combination of rich Dominican Habano and gritty USA Pennsylvania Broadleaf. Held tightly together by a savory Indonesian binder, the entire package is seamlessly dressed in a dark, lustrous Ecuadorian Habano Oscuro wrapper.This full-bodied, full-flavored smoke wastes no time making an impression. From the first light, your palate is treated to an elegant harmony of rich cedar, roasted almonds, and deep earth. As the traditional Entubado Cuban rolling method allows for a flawlessly smooth, cool draw, the blend evolves to reveal sophisticated notes of dark cocoa, fresh espresso, a zesty pop of black pepper, and a subtle caramelized sweetness on the finish.Presented in elegant 10-count boxes and dressed in premium gold foil sleeves, these limited-production sticks disappear quickly upon arrival.

A medium to full-bodied smoke with a deep earthy profile and notes of oak and cedar. This Nicaraguan puro features a sun-grown wrapper and a Nicaraguan Cuban-seed binder and filler. To enhance its flavors, the wrapper leaves are aged for 8 years and then bourbon barrel aged for 10 more months. Handmade in Nicaragua this celebratory cigar was crafted to mark Perdomo Cigars twenty years of creating memorable cigars.

A bold cigar with a sweet complexity accompanied by notes of dark cocoa and a delicious coffee finish. This Nicaraguan puro sports a Cuban-seed maduro wrapper that has been barrel aged for 15 years. This dark, mouthwatering wrapper sheaths a binder and filler composed of tobacco that has been aged for 15 years as well. The tobaccos used to create this commemorative blend were hand-selected and sourced from farms owned and operated by the Perdomo family in Nicaragua. The cigars are handmade at the Tabacalera Perdomo factory in Nicaragua. The Perdomo 30th Anniversary Box-Pressed Maduro cigar is available only through 75 carefully selected cigar retailers, which Neptune Cigars is proud to have been one of the chosen few.

A bold but not overpowering cigar with a spicy complexity accompanied by a woody and nutty finish.
