This medium-bodied smoke has an overall sweet profile highlighted by notes of cedar and spice. Its Ecuadorian DeFlorada wrapper sheaths an Ecuadorian binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. Handmade in Miami, Florida at the El Titan de Bronze factory, the Warped La Colmena Unico Especial will satisfy the palates of both traditional and contemporary smokers.

Nutty, fruity, and citrus notes add dimension to this medium-strength cigar's complexity. Its reddish Corojo '99 wrapper sheaths a dual binder made of Corojo 99 and Criollo 99 leaves, and a Corojo 99 filler. Handmade in Nicaragua by Aganorsa Leaf for Warped Cigars. The Warped La Hacienda uses traditional blending and rolling methods to create an excellent cigar that can be enjoyed anytime.

The Warped La Relatos is a medium-strength panatela that is handmade at the Aganorsa Leaf factory in Nicaragua. The La Relatos is composed of an Ecuadorian Habano Wrapper that covers a Nicaraguan binder, which contains a Nicaraguan Corojo '99 and Criollo '98 fillers. A medium-bodied stick, the Warped La Relatos provides a unique flavor profile that consists of black pepper, cream, and wood.

The Warped Limited El Oso Blanco is the much lighter shade sibling of its darker brother the El Oso (Spanish for the bear) cigar. According to Kyle Gellis, founder of Warped cigars, “the Bear has eaten too much honey.” So much so that it now sports a delicious, honey-hued Ecuadorian Desflorado Connecticut Shade wrapper. But this full-strength toro still possesses the same blend of Nicaraguan leaves for a binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan long-filler leaves of the original Oso. The Warped Limited Edition El Oso Blanco offers a potent, full-bodied smoking indulgence with noticeable peppery, spicy, and earthy notes accompanied by a smooth creaminess. The cigars are handmade at the famous El Titan de Bronze factory in Miami, Florida. Only 600 boxes of 20 cigars per box were made so order yours today before this bear goes into hibernation.

The Warped Lirio Rojo Lonsdale is a limited-release, medium-strength cigar that is composed of all Nicaraguan tobaccos from its reddish Corojo '99 wrapper to its binder, and blended filler made of Corojo '99 and Criollo '98 leaves. This exquisite blend produces a complexity of flavors that includes cinnamon, cream, fruit, and spices. The Warped Lirio Rojo is hand crafted by Aganorsa Leaf (formerly Casa Fernandez) in Esteli, Nicaragua. “Lirio Rojo” is Spanish for red lily.

A medium to full bodied smoke with a creamy, coffee, and sweetness profile accented with notes of spice. Its smooth, reddish Nicaraguan Corojo '98 wrapper cloaks a Nicaraguan Criollo '98 and Corojo '99 binder and a filler composed of Esteli and Jalapa Corojo '99 and Criollo '98, Jalapa Corojo '99 Medio Tiempo leaves from Nicaragua. Unlike its predecessor, this Moon Garden uses Medio Tiempo leaves which enhances the cigar's strength profile without being overpowering. The tobaccos used in the Warped Moon Garden is grown in farms owned by Aganorsa Leaf, which hand crafts the cigars at their factory in Nicaragua.

Soothing earthy, spicy, and cedar notes and a long finish with a dark chocolatey hint will please your palate from first to last puff. Its red-hued Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed Colorado wrapper expertly cloaks a Nicaraguan binder and filler. The cigars are handmade in the Dominican Republic. To develop the blend for the New Day, Warped Cigars carefully selected a dozen cigar retailers (Neptune Cigars being one of them) to sample three different blends and vote on their favorite. The blend with the most votes won the honor of being named the New Day. This is a limited-edition cigar, and it is exclusively available through participating cigar shops. Only 1,000 boxes of 15 cigars per box were made. Order yours today!

Upon lighting, this full-bodied cigar provides a spicy, peppery, and earthy smoking indulgence. This Nicaraguan puro sports a Corojo wrapper draped over a Criollo binder and a Criollo '98 and Corojo filler. The cigars are handmade at Aganorsa Leaf's Tabacos Valle de Jalapa factory in Nicaragua. The Warped Nicotina Belicoso received a 91 rating from Cigar Aficionado.

The Warped Sarto is a limited-production release from Warped Cigars, crafted by founder Kyle Gellis. Produced at Tabacalera La Isla, the cigar features a refined blend constructed around a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper that envelops premium Nicaraguan binder and filler tobaccos. Named after the Italian word for “tailor,” Sarto perfectly reflects Warped's approach to cigar making: precision, balance, and careful construction.

This medium-strength cigar offers sweet and peppery notes with an underlying creaminess. A Nicaraguan puro composed of a Corojo wrapper, a Nicaraguan binder, and a Criollo '98 filler. Handmade in Nicaragua by Aganorsa Leaf for Warped Cigars. The Warped Serie Gran Reserva 1988 has an effortless draw, a solid construction, and a sharp burn.

Cream, cedar, roasted nuts, and gentle spice define the Zino Honduras, an approachable medium-bodied cigar that brings a richer Honduran character to the modern Zino lineup. Smooth and balanced with a touch more depth than its Nicaraguan counterpart, it delivers an easygoing profile built for everyday smoking.Produced at the Camacho factory in Honduras for Zino, the blend features an Ecuadorian wrapper over Honduran tobaccos from Copán and the Jamastran Valley. While positioned as a follow-up to the Zino Nicaragua, the release reconnects the brand with its Honduran roots

A balanced, medium strength cigar with a spicy, nutty, and cedar profile and an underlying creaminess. Its Ecuadorian wrapper sheaths a USA Connecticut binder and a Dominican Republic and Peruvian filler. The cigar's wrapper has been aged for 2 years, its binder for 4 years, and its filler for 5 years. The combination of all these carefully aged tobaccos contribute to the cigar's savory and opulent flavor profile. Handmade in the Dominican Republic. Once rolled, each Zino Platinum Crown Series Barrel Tubo cigar is nested in an aluminum tube to protect its aged tobaccos and preserve its aroma and flavors. If you're looking for a special occasion cigar, then your search is over.

It sports an enticing Ecuadorian Habano wrapper that is superbly draped over a binder and long-filler tobaccos from the Dominican Republic. The Zino Platinum Exclusive Series artistically balances flavor and strength to create a smoking experience that is truly a masterpiece.

Its Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper covers a Dominican binder, and a Peruvian and Dominican filler. Handmade in the Dominican Republic.
